notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350040/b80204c1fc00d0fc36f6fa837d9880f65e930f39.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Update Content[/p][p]★ New MECH-type S-rank Battlesuit "Behold! Fate-Defying Dragon"[/p][p]Behold! Fate-Defying Dragon is a MECH-type Fire DMG dealer. All damage she deals is considered Ignite DMG. She wields a Rocket Hammer and is protected by Astral Ring Specialization: Rite of Oblivion. After clearing three trials, Coralie, the savior of the world, returns triumphantly in her dragonkin form. Behold, the genius Dark Lord![/p][p][/p][p]Behold! Fate-Defying Dragon can use her claws and wings to perform flashy aerial combos. In Stellar Outburst, her multi-level scorching dragon breath will burn everything to ashes.[/p][p][/p][p]*You can obtain the new battlesuit and her recommended equipment in the following ways:[/p][p]1. Overlord of Annihilation Battlesuit Supply is available. The featured S-rank battlesuit "Behold! Fate-Defying Dragon" is guaranteed in 90 drops with 50% off the first 10 drops.[/p][p][/p][p]2. Equipment Supply is available for a limited time. Recommended for Behold! Fate-Defying Dragon: Rocket Hammer "Draconic Sky-Scorching Fury" and "Gaming for Life" stigma set drop rates UP![/p][p][/p][p]3. "Dragon of the Ruins" login event begins. Log in for 7 days to obtain Gaming for Life Stigma Option x1, 120 Crystals, and more. Open the Stigma Option to choose from one of the corresponding stigmata.[/p][p][/p][p]4. "Gaming for Life" stigma set is craftable. Forging a stigma requires Source Prism x2 and Ether Fuel x600.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]★ New AstralOp Chenxue[/p][p]Chenxue is the recommended AstralOp for Grail of Infinitude and Rite of Oblivion. In Stellar Outburst, she can perform her Synergy Attack to pull in surrounding enemies and deal Fire DMG. When Grail of Infinitude is activated, entering Stellar Outburst reduces Ultimate CD for all team members, and refreshes and activates teammates' QTEs. When Rite of Oblivion is activated, Elemental DMG, Physical DMG, and Crit Rate increase for all team members.[/p][p][/p][p]*You can obtain the new AstralOp in the following ways:[/p][p]AstralOp Supply is available for a limited time. You are guaranteed to get AstralOp Chenxue in 60 AstralOp Supply drops.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]★ Part 2 Main Story Chapter IX Interlude: Yet the Stars Still Sparkle[/p][p]As a mist veils the lake, she waits for the ripples to calm, so her hands can cup the reflections of stars.[/p][p][/p][p]The new main story interlude "Yet the Stars Still Sparkle" begins. Play the main story to get Crystals, Source Prisms, HOHO Vacation Tickets, and more.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]★ Featured Event "Assemble! Summer Friendship Resort"[/p][p]A heart-throbbing game and a light-hearted adventure await. Have a summer filled with miracles at the Golden Courtyard![/p][p][/p][p]"Welcome to the World of Love created by a genius designer! Are you ready for a su... Yes, a surprise?"[/p][p][/p][p]Featured event "Assemble! Summer Friendship Resort" coming soon. Play to get Mad Pleasure: Shadowbringer's outfit "Roseate Summer", Summer at Golden Courtyard Emblem, Crystals, Source Prisms, Honkai Shards, and more.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]★ Special Event Shop "Have-All Market"[/p][p]Event shop "Have-All Market" is now open. During the event, participate in various Supply events or purchase themed bundles to obtain event shop tokens, which can be exchanged for Lone Destruction: Shadowchaser's outfit "At Your Service", Divine Key Option, Synergy Cards, Equipment Supply Cards, and more.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]★ New Event "Star-Tempering Clash"[/p][p]Go solo or team up in threes, keep the battles rolling under the gleam of tempered starlight![/p][p][/p][p]Star-Tempering Clash begins soon. Play stage battles to obtain Crystals, Tempered Starblade Emblem, Einstein's Torus, SC Metal-H2, and more.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]★ Hyperion Arsenal[/p][p]New Weapons: Rocket Hammer "Draconic Sky-Scorching Fury" and PRI-ARM Rocket Hammer "Draconic Sky-Scorching Fury: Ultra!"[/p][p][/p][p]New Stigmata: "Gaming for Life" Stigma Set[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Game Adjustments & Optimizations[/p][p]☆☆☆☆☆ Battlesuits ☆☆☆☆☆[/p][p]The following data are at max skill level:[/p][p]◆ Planar Armament: Warped Spacetime[/p][p]1. Passive Skill "Honest Feelings" unlocked.[/p][p][/p][p]2. Fixed an issue where some bridge interactions glitched.[/p][p][/p][p]3. notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350040/8feb76caf193dd4c0d76c55e7ce9eed0e178f550.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Welcome to v8.3: Flickers of a Spacetime Warp (JUN 26 ~ AUG 21)![/p][p][/p][p]Update Content[/p][p]★ New BIO-type S-rank Battlesuit "Planar Armament: Warped Spacetime"[/p][p]Planar Armament: Warped Spacetime is a BIO-type Lightning DMG dealer who wields a Rapid-Shot Crossbow. She is protected by Astral Ring Specialization: Grail of Infinitude. Now that Helia has confronted and accepted her true self, she continues to walk her own path and has unlocked new powers. She has multiple ways to quickly recover SP and can deal burst damage by connecting Ultimate sequences. During Stellar Outburst, the whole team shares SP, allowing you to synchronize SP recovery and damage dealing for lethal effects.[/p][p][/p][p]*You can obtain the new battlesuit and her recommended equipment in the following ways:[/p][p]1. "Illuminated Path Ahead" Battlesuit Supply is available. The featured S-rank battlesuit "Planar Armament: Warped Spacetime" is guaranteed in 90 drops with 50% off the first 10 drops.[/p][p][/p][p]2. Log in for 7 days to obtain Choices of Fate Stigma Option x1, 120 Crystals, and more. Open the Stigma Option to choose from one of the corresponding stigmata.[/p][p][/p][p]4. Toward Blessings and Wishes!" is available now! Play the event to get Cosmic Expression's outfit "Star-Speckled Blue", Promise of St. Freya Emblem, Crystals, Source Prisms, Honkai Shards, and more.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]★ Main Story Part 2 Chapter IX: If Destiny Concludes Today[/p][p]Though the winds of time have swept away my footprints, they remain carved in the winds' backbones. notes.title: v8.2 Roving Among Clouds Update Announcement
notes.content:
Welcome to v8.2 Roving Among Clouds (APR 24 ~ JUN 26)!


Update Content
★ New BIO-type S-rank Battlesuit Peregrine Sword
Peregrine Sword is a BIO-type Physical DMG dealer who wields Fists and is protected by Astral Ring Specialization: Law of Ascension. A wandering swordswoman must have a weapon in hand; with a bamboo umbrella that conceals a sword by her side, she can execute versatile Joint ATKs. Be careful, you'll bleed if you bump into this umbrella!

Moreover, Li Sushang's moves hit multiple times, whose damage to hit shields and addition to the combo counter are multiplied by the total number of sequences landed.

*You can obtain the new battlesuit and her recommended equipment in the following ways:
1. A Tasting Sword Battlesuit Supply is available. The featured S-rank battlesuit Peregrine Sword is guaranteed in 90 drops with 50% off the first 10 drops.

2. Equipment Supply is available for a limited time. Recommended for Peregrine Sword: Fists Jadeite Sleeves and Newfound Joys stigma set drop rates UP!

3. Travels and Feasts login event begins. Log in for 7 days to obtain Newfound Joys Stigma Option x1, 120 Crystals, and more. Open the Stigma Option to choose from one of the corresponding stigmata.

4. Newfound Joys stigma set is craftable. Forging a stigma requires Source Prism x2 and Ether Fuel x600.


★ Part 2 Main Story Chapter VIII: Till the Long Road Reaches the Sky
I once wandered through valleys, and will traverse the azure sky. Among thousands of stars, I am but a speck; above a radiant glow, I am a rainbow.

New main story Till the Long Road Reaches the Sky coming soon. Play the main story to get Crystals, Source Prisms, and more!


★ Featured Event Yunchin's Culinary Wonders
Savor and relish every bite! Valkyries protect the safety of the masses and ensure their appetites are never lost! Time to feast!

Featured event Yunchin's Culinary Wonders is here! Run a restaurant with Li Sushang, Susannah, Seele, and other Valkyries. Play the event to obtain Valkyrie Boltstorm's outfit Salted Plum, Crystals, Stuffed Tummy Emblem, Source Prisms, Honkai Shards, and more!


★ Version Event Snazzy Cards Championship
Snazzy Cards Championship begins! Collect and upgrade Snazzy Cards in the event to build decks for challenges. Play the event to claim Crystals, Source Prisms, Honkai Shards, Azure Silhouette Outfit Option, and more!

*Open Azure Silhouette Outfit Option to choose from one of the following: outfit Immortal Blades Uniform, outfit Verdant Sky, outfit Orochi Cuirass, or 8000 Asterite.


★ Panel Event Little Helpers, Big Rewards!
Little Helpers, Big Rewards! event starts! During the event, log in and play the new version content to complete event missions and get Blazing Assembly ELF Option x1, Operation Terminals, ADV Skill Materials, and more.

*Open Blazing Assembly ELF Option to choose one ELF from all existing ELFs or Reroll Device: ATK Option Type C.


★ Hyperion Arsenal
New Weapons: Fists Jadeite Sleeves, and PRI-ARM Fists Jadeite Sleeves: Windward

New Stigmata: Newfound Joys Stigma Set



Game Adjustments & Optimizations
☆☆☆☆☆ Battlesuits ☆☆☆☆☆
The following data are at max skill level:

◆ Ba-Dum! Fiery Wishing Star
1. Fixed an issue where she incorrectly recovered additional Fortune during aerial Basic ATK SEQ 4 when multiple enemies entered the attack range and were hit.

2. Fixed an issue where her character skill Lanterns Flickering in the Peaceful Neighborhood sometimes failed to take effect when only one enemy was on the field.

3. Fixed an issue where her voice lines sometimes glitched and did not play when casting Stellar Shift.

4. Fixed an issue where the terminology of character skill descriptions incorrectly included "Majestic Fortune Drum".

5. Fixed an issue where her Basic ATK VFX sometimes glitched.

6. Fixed an issue where the shadow of her weapon sometimes glitched and failed to display.

7. Fixed an issue where her aerial Combo ATK did not hit enemies but Happy Days Ahead 3-piece stigma set bonus of all team members gaining Let's Have Fun! when she entered Stellar Outburst or entered the battle as the leader was incorrectly triggered.


◆ Herrscher of Finality
Fixed an issue where the skill animation sometimes glitched and was interrupted when she cast Weapon Skill.


◆ Herrscher of Human: Ego
1. Fixed an issue where Rime Trauma inflicted on enemies sometimes glitches during Stellar Outburst when she was equipped with Flawless Benediction or Flawless Benediction: Legacy.

2. Fixed an issue she sometimes glitched and could not exit the Herrscher of Origin form when Astral Ring was activated and she was the leader and teammates not protected by Astral Ring Specialization: Wheel of Destiny entered Stellar Outburst.

3. Improved the text description of Astral Ring skill What Begins With Me Ends With Me when she is equipped with Flawless Benediction or Flawless Benediction: Legacy. This is only a text correction, and it does not affect the actual effects. Descriptions related to Pristine Seed in the sub-skill description of Tender, Like the Love of Petals will be listed under the main skill description of What Begins With Me Ends With Me.


◆ Sugary Starburst
Fixed an issue where her Charged ATK was incorrectly recognized as a Weapon Skill with some stigmata.


◆ Jovial Deception: Shadowdimmer
Fixed an issue where anti-aliasing effects sometimes glitched after she cast Ultimate.


◆ Herrscher of Flamescion
Fixed an issue where the 2-Handed sword model sometimes glitched while she was in the Time Runner outfit.


◆ Lone Planetfarer
Fixed an issue where her hair sometimes glitched during the animation of Nihilation of Planets when she was in the Eldritch Vantage outfit.


◆ Bright Knight: Excelsis
Fixed an issue where her hair sometimes glitched in certain stages.


◆ Thousand-Faced Maestro: Cameo!
Fixed an issue where her character model sometimes glitched on the finalization screen when she was in the Fictitious Game outfit.


◆ Argent Knight: Artemis
Fixed an issue where her character model sometimes glitched when taking hits while she was in the Vow of Roses outfit.


◆ Reign Solaris
1. A text correction of Ultimate Dauntless Advance has been made. This is only a text correction, and it does not affect the actual effects.

2. Fixed an issue where her avatar incorrectly displayed Heavenly Link as available during the CD of Astral Ring skill: When Law of Ascension is activated and she is not the leader, the leader's Heavenly Link can be triggered once when QTE hits enemies. This is only a display correction and doesn't affect the actual skill effects.

◆ Valorous Effulgence & Valorous Effulgence: New Voyage
Improved weapon active's text descriptions. This is only a text correction, and it does not affect the actual effects.


◆ Flawless Benediction & Flawless Benediction: Legacy
1. A text correction of the weapon active description has been made. This is only a text correction and does not affect the actual skill effects.

2. Fixed an issue where weapon VFX sometimes glitched in the Valkyrie System.


◆ Cleaver of Shamash
Fixed an issue where the model sometimes glitched.



☆☆☆☆☆ AstralOps ☆☆☆☆☆
◆ Theresa Apocalypse
1. Fixed an issue where passive skill effect of Hymn of Celestial Harmony: HP loss effect dealt by the Leader Skill increases, sometimes glitched and did not take effect on the HP loss effect of Reign Solaris's skill My Body, An Anchor.

2. Fixed an issue where the Vulnerability inflicted by Recharge Skill Celestial Oath sometimes glitched and lasted for an abnormal duration when Law of Ascension is triggered with this AstralOp and there are teammates without the Heavenly Shift trait.



☆☆☆☆☆ Gameplay ☆☆☆☆☆
◆ Superstring Dimension
1. New stage: Shift: Perilous, featuring "Lantern" as the main enemy.

2. New stage: Inferno: Perilous, featuring MHT-3C Retaliator as the main enemy.

3. New stage: Stardust: Perilous, featuring Creeper and Alien Guard - Gleaning as the main enemies.

4. New stage: Blood Thorns: Perilous, featuring Herrscher of Corruption as the main enemy.

5. New stage: Blood Thorns: Perilous, featuring Husk - Nihilius as the main enemy.

6. Adjusted the max HP of Jizo Mitama in Dominance: Perilous.

7. Adjusted the max HP of Cruising Tribunala in Blood Thorns: Perilous.

8. Fixed an issue where the movement of boss Dominator of Wolves sometimes glitched during phase change in Shift: Perilous.

9. Fixed an issue where Starless: Perilous (Main enemy: Fu Hua) sometimes lagged.

10. Fixed an issue where Herrscher of Finality sometimes glitched and did not restore Descent after evading Thorns of Wishing during boss Sprout of Wishing's phase change in Nemesis: Perilous.

11. Fixed an issue where the range effects failed to vanish after the furnace activation ended in Inferno: Intensive.

12. A text correction to the skill description of Husk - Existentialism's Barren Smash was made.

13. Fixed an issue where characters in Augmented Ascension when Astral Ring Specialization: Law of Ascension is activated failed to gain the Stellar Environment weather buff: "During Stellar Outburst, further increases the Total DMG of all team members by 20%."

14. Fixed an issue where characters in Augmented Ascension when Astral Ring Specialization: Law of Ascension was activated incorrectly received the Starless Environment weather buff: "When outside Stellar Outburst, all team members deal 15% more Total DMG."


◆ Memorial Arena
1. New SSS boss: "Lantern"

2. Fixed an issue where the battle timer sometimes glitched and failed to stop tracking the time after Mad Pleasure: Shadowbringer cast Ultimate when equipped with Banquet Rose: Faux Crown and SSS boss Huodou entered phase change during Time-frozen Domain.


◆ Elysian Realm
1. New playable battlesuit: Peregrine Sword

2. The replaceable boss for Floor 17 of Deep Sequence is now Pishacha.

3. Updated the stage effects and buff effects of Deep Sequence.

4. Fixed an issue where the display of HOMU Magician's hat sometimes glitched.

5. Fixed an issue where the [Expand] button sometimes glitched and did not display in the Elysian Realm Lobby.

6. Fixed an issue where the Rend count sometimes glitched when the effects of Nexus Signet of Daybreak: Wings that Mask the Sanguine Moon and Horns that Rip the Bleak Sky were triggered simultaneously.

7. Fixed an issue where the DMG Reduction count of Normal Signet of Infinity's Silent [B] sometimes glitched.


◆ Part 2 Main Story
1. Fixed an issue in Part 2 Main Story's map where scene loading sometimes glitched and flickered.

2. Fixed an issue in Part 2 Main Story's map where anti-aliasing effects sometimes glitched when Graphics setting - Shadow Quality was set to "Mid".

3. Fixed an issue where the movement of some characters sometimes glitched in some Part 2 Main Story chapters.

4. Optimized the running animation for AstralOps in Oxia and Hyperion 11.

5. Fixed an issue where the Ore Jukebox sometimes glitched and did not play background music.


◆ Featured Event Ongoing: Make-A-Wish Fest!
1. Fixed an issue where the countdown display sometimes glitched.

2. Fixed an issue where unlocked stages in Paradise Fiesta incorrectly displayed as locked.

3. Optimized the sorting method for Fate Bonds with the same number of counts.



☆☆☆☆☆ Shop ☆☆☆☆☆
◆ Exchange House
Added weapon Whisper of the Past, weapon Obscuring Wing, stigma Pristine Elf, and stigma Poem of Raven.


◆ Witch's Corridor
Herrscher of Human: Ego Rank-Up Stamp is now purchasable with Pure Witch Orbs.



☆☆☆☆☆ Battle Pass ☆☆☆☆☆
1. Adjusted the upgrade function for BP Theme.

2. Adjusted the duration, rewards cap, and rewards content of BP Rewards.

3. Adjusted the BP points cap, carry over rules, and exchange methods.

4. Added Reserve Works to BP Shops and BP Materials to BP Works.

*Please refer to the in-game BP interface and BP announcement for more details on the adjustments.



☆☆☆☆☆ System ☆☆☆☆☆
◆ Foundry
You can now craft G4 stigma set Cezanne and Prism Stigma Li Sushang: Peregrine Sword directly.


◆ Bridge Interactions
Added interactive animations and voice lines for Peregrine Sword.


◆ Achievements
Added the achievement for obtaining Peregrine Sword.


◆ Appreciation Mode
1. New AstralOp Appreciation Mode

2. Fixed an issue in Appreciation Mode where the hair of some character models sometimes glitched.

3. Fixed an issue in the Valkyrie screen's Appreciation Mode where some characters' feet sometimes glitched and staggered.


◆ Archive
Fixed incorrect content in Archive for enemies Tough Barbed and Shadow Drinker - Azur Flame.


◆ Dorm
Peregrine Sword can now move into the Dorm. Her interactions and events are now available.


◆ Starter's System
Adjusted some rewards in Starter Bundle, Starter's Manual, and Starter Login Event.


◆ Returnee System
1. Adjusted the event interface of Returnee System.

2. Adjusted the reward acquisition method of Returnee System and optimized the format of returnee compensation.


◆ AstralOp System
1. New Quick Upgrade function for AstralOp and ELF skills.

2. Fixed an issue where the AstralOp system sometimes glitched and was abnormally activated in Elysium Everlasting and Kolosten.


◆ Others
1. Increased the storage limit of Coins.

2. New emblem collection feature and optimized emblem sorting.

3. Adjusted the challenge objectives of some Material Expeditions.

4. Fixed an issue where characters and weapons were sometimes mismatched when equipping Valkyries with weapons in the Valkyrie system.

5. Fixed an issue where characters in Stellar Outburst were sometimes abnormally affected by the gravitation effects of enemy skills when Astral Ring Specialization: Law of Ascension was activated.

6. Fixed an issue where some Combo ATKs sometimes glitched and led to abnormal jumping when using Keyboard and Mouse Mode.

7. Fixed an issue where the right joystick sometimes glitched and failed to rotate the camera angle when switching from Controller to Keyboard and Mouse mode.

8. Fixed an issue where characters sometimes fell out of the map in Challenge 03 of Everlasting Memory in Chronicles.

notes.title: v8.1 Drumming in New Resolutions Update Announcement
notes.content:
Welcome to v8.1: Drumming in New Resolutions (FEB 20 ~ APR 24)!


Update Content
★ New S-rank SD-type Battlesuit Ba-Dum! Fiery Wishing Star
Ba-Dum! Fiery Wishing Star is an SD-type Fire DMG dealer who fights with pistols. On the battlefield, she wields a long staff and takes the stage with Rice Cake! As the Spring Festival's messenger, Kiana battles single or multiple enemies in a festive manner. You will hear "Ba-dum→ Ba-dum ba-dum↗ Ba-dum" as monsters are knocked unconscious and sent to dreamland to have sweet dreams.

She is protected by Astral Ring Specialization: Law of Ascension. When she is the leader and enters Stellar Outburst, she will automatically cast Stellar Shift (powerful entry skill) the next time she enters the field to deal DMG to enemies.

*You can obtain the new battlesuit and her recommended equipment in the following ways:
1. Wishes Made Tonight Battlesuit Supply is available. The featured S-rank battlesuit Ba-Dum! Fiery Wishing Star is guaranteed in 90 drops with 50% off the first 10 drops.

2. Equipment Supply is available for a limited time. Recommended for Ba-Dum! Fiery Wishing Star: Pistols Fortuitous Red and Happy Days Ahead stigma set drop rates UP!

3. Lyrical Beginning login event begins. Log in for 7 days to obtain Happy Days Ahead Stigma Option x1, Ode to Eunomia Stigma Option x1, and Equipment Supply Card x10. Open the Stigma Options to choose from one of the corresponding recommended stigmata.

4. Ba-Dum! Fiery Wishing Star's stigma set is craftable. Forging a stigma requires Source Prism x2 and Ether Fuel x600.


★ Part 2 Main Story Chapter VII Interlude: To None May God Pray
Only wounds adorn the night sky where dawn never breaks. They are known as stars.

New Main Story Interlude: To None May God Pray coming soon. Play the main story to get Crystals, Source Prisms, Ancient Willpowers, and more!


★ Featured Event Ongoing: Make-A-Wish Fest!
This amusement park holds no worries or sorrows, only joy and hope... Wait! Where did all these tears come from?!

Featured event Ongoing: Make-A-Wish Fest! begins! Strategically purchase Yearly Chibis, activate Fate Bonds, and select Lucky Charms to strengthen your lineup rapidly! Defeat Yearly Beasts in each round and preserve your Vitality until the very end! Play the event to get Valkyrie Blastmetal's new outfit Puppy Patrol, Star of Amusement Emblem, Crystals, Source Prisms, and more!


★ Featured Event Celebration Lobby 2025
Celebration Lobby 2025 begins! Celebrate the Spring Festival with Kiana and the Valkyries! Play the event to get Crystals, Source Prisms, Ancient Assist Gift Box 2025, Growth Assist Gift Box 2025, HOMU of Sssuccess Emblem, and more!


★ Login Event A New Chapter of Music
Login event A New Chapter of Music begins. During the event, log in 8 days to get an S-rank Battlesuit Option 2025, Battlesuit Supply Cards, Auspicious Drumming Commemoration Ribbon, and Crystals!


★ Anniversary Spend Bonuses
Spend 30000 Crystals in Supply events to get Lunar Vow: Crimson Love's new outfit Redolent in Red!

You can also exchange for Herrscher of Rebirth Character Card, Herrscher of Rebirth Rank-up Stamps, Dreamweaver Rank-up Stamps, and more at the event shop!


★ New S-rank AstralOp Theresa Apocalypse
Theresa Apocalypse is the recommended AstralOp for Law of Ascension. In Stellar Outburst, Theresa will cast her Synergy ATK to draw in surrounding enemies and deal Lightning DMG to enemies in the range. When Ba-Dum! Fiery Wishing Star is in Stellar Outburst, even more Lightning DMG is dealt to enemies.

When Law of Ascension is activated, enemies take more Total DMG from QTE and Stellar Shift. When a teammate's Stellar Shift hits enemies, Theresa will assist and deal Lightning DMG with supporting light spears.

*You can obtain the new AstralOp in the following ways:
AstralOp Supply available for a limited time. You are guaranteed to get S-rank AstralOp Theresa Apocalypse in 60 AstralOp Supply drops.


★ New equipment recommended for Herrscher of Human: Ego: Divine Key Flawless Benediction and Ode to Eunomia stigma set
Divine Key for Herrscher of Human: Ego: Flawless Benediction and PRI-ARM Flawless Benediction: Legacy debut! When Herrscher of Human: Ego is equipped with them, activate Astral Ring Specialization: Wheel of Destiny to change her Weapon Skill.

*You can obtain her recommended equipment in the following ways:
1. Equipment Supply available for a limited time! Herrscher of Human: Ego's recommended equipment Divine Key Flawless Benediction and Ode to Eunomia stigma set are available with increased drop rates!

2. Participate in the login event to get Ode to Eunomia Stigma Option x1. Open it to receive one of Herrscher of Human: Ego's new recommended stigmata.

3. Ode to Eunomia stigma set is craftable. Forging a stigma requires Source Prism x2 and Ether Fuel x600.


★ Outfit Supply Skybound Stairway
During v8.1, Outfit Supply Skybound Stairway is available. You can obtain Lone Planetfarer's outfit Eldritch Vantage in 10 drops (costs 9600 Crystals).


★ Hyperion Arsenal
New Weapons: Pistols Fortuitous Red, Divine Key Flawless Benediction, PRI-ARM Pistols Fortuitous Red: Dreams Come True, PRI-ARM Divine Key Flawless Benediction: Legacy

New Stigmata: Happy Days Ahead stigma set, Ode to Eunomia stigma set



Game Adjustments & Optimizations
☆☆☆☆☆ Battlesuits ☆☆☆☆☆
The following data are at max skill level:

◆ Reign Solaris
1. Fixed an issue where the time taken to switch teammates sometimes glitched when she was the leader and Astral Ring Specialization: Law of Ascension was activated.

2. Edited the skill description of Ultimate sub-skill Holy Sword's Chant. This is only a text correction, and it does not affect the actual effects.

3. Edited the skill description of Leader Skill Commanding Polarity. This is only a text correction, and it does not affect the actual effects.


◆ Lone Planetfarer
1. Fixed an issue where the animation sometimes glitched when [ULT] was tapped to summon Star Traveler in Superstring Dimension, Bloodbane: Perilous (main enemy: Otto Apocalypse).

2. Adjusted Astral Ring sub-skill Pleasant Duty when Law of Ascension is activated and she is not the leader: On hit, enhanced Basic ATK SEQ 4 also "consumes this character's Stellar Drain and Abyssal Energy, restores 15 SP to her," clears the leader's switch CD, and triggers the leader's QTE. Other parts of the description remain unchanged.


◆ Fenghuang of Vicissitude
Fixed an issue when she was in the Crane of Taixuan outfit and her movements sometimes glitched in story dialog.



☆☆☆☆☆ Weapons ☆☆☆☆☆
◆ Skyveil Feathers & Skyveil Feathers: Purifying Wish
Adjusted active skill effects: "When entering battle, consuming Stellar Drain for the first time with a Combo ATK restores 15 bonus Astral Ring Intensity" changed to "When entering battle, hitting enemies with Celestial Rupture for the first time restores 15 bonus Astral Ring Intensity." Disabled upon activating Stellar Outburst. Other parts of the description remain unchanged.



☆☆☆☆☆ Gameplay ☆☆☆☆☆
◆ Superstring Dimension
1. New stage: Stardust: Perilous, featuring Sa: Wheel of Transcendence as the main enemy.

2. New stage: Shift: Perilous, featuring HOMU Performer as the main enemy.

3. New stage: Nemesis: Perilous, featuring Sprout of Wishing as the main enemy.

4. New stage: Bloodbane: Perilous, featuring HoD Minion as the main enemy.

5. New stage: Shift: Perilous, featuring Dominator of Wolves as the main enemy.

6. New stage: Shift: Perilous, featuring MHT-3C Retaliator as the main enemy.

notes.title: v8.0 In Search of the Sun Update Announcement
notes.content:
Welcome to v8.0: In Search of the Sun!


Update Content
★ New IMG-type S-rank Battlesuit Reign Solaris
Reign Solaris is an IMG-type Physical DMG dealer. Nimble and agile, she rides a hoverboard to zip past enemies. Her javelin pierces enemies like a streaking bolt of light as she dominates the battlefield. She is protected by Astral Ring Specialization: Law of Ascension. After she enters Stellar Outburst, she automatically casts an enhanced entry attack the next time she is switched in.

*You can obtain the new battlesuit and her recommended equipment in the following ways:
1. Solar Radiance Battlesuit Supply is available. The featured S-rank battlesuit Reign Solaris is guaranteed in 90 drops with 50% off the first 10 drops.

2. Equipment Supply is available for a limited time. Recommended for Reign Solaris: Javelin Valorous Effulgence and Illuminating the Universe stigma set drop rates UP!

3. Glowing Sun and Stars login event begins. Log in for 7 days to obtain Illuminating the Universe Stigma Option x1, 120 Crystals, and more. Open Illuminating the Universe Stigma Option to choose from one of Reign Solaris's recommended stigmata.

4. Illuminating the Universe stigma set is craftable. Forging a stigma requires Source Prism x2 and Ether Fuel x600.


★ Part 2 Chapter VII: Bouquets of Unfulfilled Wishes
I offer you a final sunset and a stagnant sky; I offer you a bouquet of mottled memories and a starry sky of silence.

New main story Bouquets of Unfulfilled Wishes begins. Play the main story and event Clean-up Masters On Duty! to get Crystals, Source Prisms, Ancient Willpowers, and more.


★ Bonuses Events Shiny and Sparkling and Treasure Hunt Celebration
During the events, play the new version and complete event missions for a share from a generous pool of Crystals. Get chances to participate in raffles for a character figurine, selected S-rank battlesuits, max level recommended equipment, Paladin BP Unlock Coupon, Crystals, and more!


★ Featured Event Countdown: To Sweet Dreams!
Rice Cake, master of New Year's Land, will assist Kiana as she obtains the power to command monsters. She will transform into her monster followers and fight. Play the event to get Deepspace Anchor: First Light's new outfit Steering Inequations, Crystals, Source Prisms, Honkai Shards, and more.


★ Hyperion Arsenal
New weapons: Valorous Effulgence and PRI-ARM Valorous Effulgence: New Voyage.

New stigmata: Illuminating the Universe stigma set.



Game Adjustments & Optimizations
☆☆☆☆☆ Battlesuits ☆☆☆☆☆
The following data are at max skill level:
◆ Thousand-Faced Maestro: Cameo!
1. Fixed an issue in some stages where the lighting sometimes glitched on the finalization screen for her.

2. Fixed an issue where she sometimes glitched and could cast Ultimate Temp Lead on fallen teammates.

3. Fixed an issue during combat against boss Dominator of Wolves where she sometimes glitched when casting Combo ATK I Am Elation!.

4. Fixed an issue where some special effects sometimes glitched after Thousand-Faced Maestro: Cameo! cast Ultimate Thousand-Faced Fool, when Fenghuang of Vicissitude was in the Crane of Taixuan outfit.

5. Fixed an issue where the effect "Quantum Collapse effect of Spectacular Support will be triggered for another time" in active skills Wonderous Game and Extravagant Mischief sometimes activated abnormally when she was equipped with Volatile Sparkler or Volatile Sparkler: Floral Spectacle.

6. Fixed an issue on the Valkyrie screen where her character model's skirt sometimes glitched when she was in the Fictitious Game outfit.

7. Fixed an issue where the display of Quantum Mech Energy for her sometimes glitched.


◆ Jovial Deception: Shadowdimmer
Fixed an issue in Part 2 Main Story's map where the lighting sometimes glitched when Jovial Deception: Shadowdimmer cast Ultimate.


◆ Deepspace Anchor: First Light
Fixed an issue where Deepspace Anchor: First Light's movements sometimes glitched when she was in some sandbox scenes.


◆ Fenghuang of Vicissitude
Fixed an issue where she sometimes fell out of the map after casting Ultimate.


◆ Herrscher of Finality
1. Fixed an issue where she glitched and sometimes could not jump.

2. Fixed an issue where her facial expressions sometimes glitched when she casts Ultimate Go Kiana! when she is equipped with her recommended weapons Waxing Moon or Waxing Moon: Incipience.


◆ Herrscher of Flamescion
Fixed an issue where the special effects of her cloak sometimes glitched.


◆ Others
Unlocked Astral Ring skills corresponding to the Heavenly Shift trait for Jovial Deception: Shadowdimmer, Lone Planetfarer, and Thousand-Faced Maestro: Cameo!.



☆☆☆☆☆ Weapons ☆☆☆☆☆
◆ Waxing Moon and Waxing Moon: Incipience
Improved weapon text descriptions. This is only a text correction, and it does not affect the actual effects.



☆☆☆☆☆ AstralOps ☆☆☆☆☆
◆ Serapeum
Fixed an issue where the effect "When World Star is activated, the character recovers Astral Ring Intensity by releasing Resonance attacks" from her Recharge Skill A Heart for Lya sometimes glitched and failed to trigger.


◆ Others
Fixed an issue where AstralOp bridge interactions sometimes glitched and failed to be triggered.



☆☆☆☆☆ Gameplay ☆☆☆☆☆
◆ Part 2 Main Story
1. Added main story map: Tower of Ruimu: God's Residence that can be unlocked through Part 2 Main Story Chapter VII missions.

2. Fixed an issue in Excavate? Pursuit? Big Winner! where the red dot indicator sometimes glitched and displayed abnormally.

3. Fixed an issue in the main story where the rendering of Coralie's hair color sometimes glitched on some Android devices.

4. Fixed an issue in the main story where the rendering of some characters' facial lighting sometimes glitched on some Android devices.

5. Fixed an issue in the main story where scene lighting sometimes glitched on some Android devices.

6. Fixed an issue in Main Story Chapters I to III where the achievement Piercing Water could not be completed.

7. Fixed an issue in Main Story Chapters I to III where the screen sometimes turned black for some missions.

8. Fixed an issue where the model of boss Perception in Boss Review sometimes glitched and was wrongly positioned during combat.

9. Optimized some NPC animations in the main story map: Ruimu.


◆ Part 1 Main Story
1. Fixed an issue in Main Story Chapters XXIX ~ XXXI where the stage Data Storm sometimes glitched and did not start when no ELFs were deployed.

2. Fixed an issue in Main Story Chapter XVIII where characters sometimes fell out of the scene.


◆ Open World
Fixed an issue in APHO Chapter 2 where adventure tasks and activated maps were sometimes mismatched.


◆ Superstring Dimension

8. Adjusted the max HP of Hellmaru in Symphony: Perilous.

9. Adjusted the max HP of MHT-3C Retaliator in Shadow: Perilous.

10. Adjusted some weather stats as follows:
Stellar Environment: During Stellar Outburst, bonus Total DMG dealt by all teammates increased from 10% to 20%. Other effects remain unchanged.

Starless Environment: When the Astral Ring system is not activated, bonus Total DMG dealt by all teammates increased from 30% to 50%. Other effects remain unchanged.

Shadow Environment: When Shadow Star Attack hits enemies, bonus Total DMG dealt by the battlesuit on the field increased from 30% to 50%. Other effects remain unchanged.

Echoing Environment: For every teammate with the Domain Resonance trait, bonus Total DMG dealt by all teammates increased from 5% to 10%. When World Star is activated, bonus Total DMG dealt by all teammates increased from 30% to 40%.

Stellar Crown Environment: For every teammate with the Omniscient Star trait, bonus Total DMG dealt by all teammates increased from 8% to 10%. When Rite of Oblivion is activated, bonus Total DMG dealt by all teammates increased from 30% to 40%.


◆ Memorial Arena
1. New C~SS boss: Kevin Kaslana and SSS boss: Bygone Deliverance

2. Fixed an issue where characters sometimes glitched and failed to deflect Vita's Wheel when bringing ELF Kiana Kaslana to the battle against SSS-rank Boss Vita: Sea's Depths.

3. Fixed an issue where Valkyrie Quicksand's Ultimate One Thousand and One Fantasies sometimes glitched and was interrupted during the battle against C~SS-rank Boss Vita: Sea's Depths.

4. Fixed an issue with SSS-rank Boss Vita: Sea's Depths's initial phase where battlesuits sometimes glitched when deflecting Vita's Wheel and failed to restore SP.

5. Fixed an issue where SSS-rank boss Valrahal was sometimes abnormally hit by Stygian Nymph's Ultimate during phase change.


◆ Elysian Realm
1. New playable battlesuit: Reign Solaris

2. Updated the stage effects and buff effects of Deep Sequence.

3. The replaceable boss for Floor 17 of Deep Sequence is now HoD Minion.

4. Adjusted some stats of Thousand-Faced Maestro: Cameo!'s exclusive Signet Blessing of the Thousand-Faced before enhancement: Ultimate changed to Temp Lead. Temp Lead: Casting it forcibly unleashes the support skill. Bonus Fire DMG dealt increased from 400% to 600% ATK, similar with the stats after enhancement. Other effects remain unchanged.

5. Fixed an issue when Thousand-Faced Maestro: Cameo! is equipped with Signets Blessing of Dream Scales and Blessing of the Thousand-Faced, where the effect of Ultimate dealing bonus Fire DMG due to Blessing of Dream Scales failed to take effect.

6. Fixed an issue in Floor 17 of Deep Sequence, where the type of boss Beast of Sacrifice was inconsistent with the Boss Preview on the prep screen.

7. Fixed an issue in Deep Sequence where the challenge score sometimes glitched and incorrectly displayed "0".



☆☆☆☆☆ Shop ☆☆☆☆☆
◆ Exchange House
Added stigmata Turgenev and Verne.


◆ Elysian Shop
Disciplinary Perdition Rank-Up Stamps will be available, unlocked after clearing Deep Sequence on Inferno and higher with Disciplinary Perdition.



☆☆☆☆☆ Battle Pass ☆☆☆☆☆
1. Added the following purchasable items to BP Works:
[Character Card/Rank-Up Stamp] Dreamweaver Character Card/Rank-Up Stamps, Dreamweaver Rank-Up Stamps (Knight BP or Paladin BP required)
[Weapon] Prophetic Dreams
[Stigmata] As You Wish set: Alexandra

2. Unlock Paladin BP to get Sun-kissed Earth Ribbon.

3. Unlock Knight BP/Paladin BP to get BP Robevyom v8.0. Open it to receive one of the following: Crimson Carol (outfit), Simply Orange (outfit), Everdream (outfit), Indelible Memories (outfit), or 8000 Asterite.

4. BP Arsenal token changed to Honor Chip v8.0 and Provisions Crate changed to Provisions Crate v8.0.



☆☆☆☆☆ System ☆☆☆☆☆
◆ Foundry
You can now craft G4 stigma set Bastet and Prism Stigma set Illuminating the Universe directly.


◆ Bridge Interactions
1. Added interactive animations and voice lines for Reign Solaris.

2. Fixed an issue where the background lighting sometimes glitched on the bridge screen.


◆ Achievements
Added the achievement for obtaining Reign Solaris.


◆ Dorm
Reign Solaris can now move into the Dorm. Her interactions and events are now available.


◆ Returnee and Starter System
Updated the rewards and missions of returnee and starter systems.


◆ Others
1. Fixed an issue where in-game sound effects sometimes glitched and did not play after exiting web events.

2. Fixed an issue on PC where controller functions sometimes glitched when the game was running in the background.

3. Optimized the recommended Graphics Quality setting on some Android devices.

notes.title: v7.9 Stars Derailed Update Announcement
notes.content:
Welcome to v7.9 Stars Derailed (NOV 28 ~ JAN 9)! Honkai Impact 3rd x Honkai: Star Rail crossover officially begins!
 
 
Update Content
★ New QUA-type S-rank battlesuit Thousand-Faced Maestro: Cameo!
Thousand-Faced Maestro: Cameo! is a QUA-type Fire DMG dealer protected by World Star. She uses a Drive Core that turns into a revolver in battle, and transforms the battlefield into a stage for her performance. With a variety of props, she puts on a spectacular show as she defeats enemies. She also plays the role of a director as she casts her Ultimate and selects the perfect performer to take the stage.
 
*You can obtain the new battlesuit and her recommended equipment in the following ways:
1. Wonderous Co-Star Battlesuit Supply is available. The featured S-rank battlesuit Thousand-Faced Maestro: Cameo! is guaranteed in 90 drops with 50% off the first 10 drops.
 
2. Equipment Supply is available for a limited time! Recommended for Thousand-Faced Maestro: Cameo!: Drive Core Volatile Sparkler and Inimitable Stage Director stigma set drop rates UP!
 
3. Joyous Comedy login event is available! Log in for 7 days to obtain Inimitable Stage Director Stigma Option x1, 120 Crystals, 2800 Asterite, and AE Imaginon x5. Open Inimitable Stage Director Stigma Option to choose from one of Thousand-Faced Maestro: Cameo!'s recommended stigmata.
 
4. Inimitable Stage Director stigma set is craftable. Forging a stigma requires Source Prism x2 and Ether Fuel x600.
 
 
★ Featured Event: Honkai: A Fool's Hand
Are you curious about what secrets lie under the mask? Well... Let's start with a round of A Fool's Hand!
 
Crossover featured event Honkai: A Fool's Hand begins. Play the event to get Thousand-Faced Maestro: Cameo!'s new outfit Fictitious Game, Best Player Emblem, Crystals, Source Prisms, and more. Claim up to 1000 Crystals through the event!
 
 
★ Part 2 Main Story Chapter VI: Wails Stifled by the Silent Shadow
The pursuit of light is a mistake, and so are those futile thoughts... and persistent wails.
 
New main story Wails Stifled by the Silent Shadow begins. Play the main story and event Excavate? Pursuit? Big Winner! to get Crystals, Source Prisms, Ancient Willpowers, and more.
 
 
★ Bonuses Event: When Petals Flutter
When Petals Flutter begins! During the event, complete 4 of 5 event missions to get Herrscher of Human: Ego Character Card!
 
 
★ Login Event: Surprising Encore
During the event, log in and tap the button at the bottom of the bridge to receive Sparkle's letter and Battlesuit Supply Card x5.
 
 
★ Limited-time Top-up Bonuses: Starry Wishes
During the event, accumulate top-ups to claim Weapon Direct Level-Up Coupon, Herrscher of Finality/Dreamweaver Rank-Up Stamps, Source Prisms, Supply Cards, HOHO Vacation Tickets, and more!
 
 
★ Limited-time Event: Snazzy Cards Club
Play a thrilling round of Snazzy Cards. If you win, the prizes are yours. If you lose... Well, that will never happen!
 
During the Snazzy Cards Club event, play to claim Dazzling Elegance Outfit Option, Snazzy Cards Grandmaster Emblem, Crystals, Source Prisms, and more.
 
*Open Dazzling Elegance Outfit Option to receive one of the following: Before the Dawn (outfit), Freestyle Special (outfit), Rustic Noir (outfit), or 8000 Asterite.
 
 
★ Hyperion Arsenal
New Weapons: Drive Core Volatile Sparkler, PRI-ARM Drive Core Volatile Sparkler: Floral Spectacle
 
New Stigmata: Inimitable Stage Director Stigma Set
 
 
 
Game Adjustments & Optimizations
☆☆☆☆☆ Battlesuits ☆☆☆☆☆
The following data are at max skill level:
◆ Lone Planetfarer
1. Added skill switch button for Weapon Subskill Bygone Shadow.
 
2. Fixed an issue where the lighting of her face sometimes glitched in some stages.
 
3. Fixed an issue in Planet Quaker form where enhanced Basic ATK SEQ 3 sometimes glitched and still dealt DMG and restored Intelligence when interrupted.
 
4. Fixed an issue in Planet Quaker form where enhanced Basic ATK SEQ 3 sometimes glitched and was not cast properly.
 
5. Fixed an issue where the animation for entering Planet Quaker form for the first time sometimes glitched on certain devices.
 
6. Fixed an issue where her model sometimes glitched during Part 2's Open World dialog.
 
7. Fixed an issue where the VFX sometimes glitched when casting Ultimate for the first time.
 
 
◆ Schicksal's Imperative
Fixed an issue where her weapon sometimes glitched in the Open World game mode.
 
 
◆ Jovial Deception: Shadowdimmer
Fixed an issue where the duration of her QTE sometimes glitched after certain characters' Stellar Outburst ends.
 
 
◆ Mad Pleasure: Shadowbringer
Adjusted her hitbox in Part 2's Open World when she is in the Gentle is the Night outfit.
 
 
◆ Fenghuang of Vicissitude
1. Fixed an issue where Feather Burning Mark sometimes glitched and was not triggered after casting her Special ATK.
 
2. Fixed an issue in Superstring Dimension, Inferno: Perilous (main enemy: Herrscher of the Rimestar), where casting Ultimate caused her to glitch and suspend in midair.
 
 
◆ Herrscher of Finality
1. Fixed an issue where Combo ATK Finale stance sometimes glitched and was wrongly triggered when she was equipped with Waxing Moon or Waxing Moon: Incipience.
 
2. Fixed an issue where weapon active sometimes glitched and failed to deal DMG when she was equipped with Waxing Moon or Waxing Moon: Incipience.
 
3. Fixed an issue where enemies sometimes glitched and were suspended in midair when she was equipped with Waxing Moon or Waxing Moon: Incipience.
 
4. Fixed an issue where Astral Ring sometimes glitched and was not activated when she was equipped with Waxing Moon or Waxing Moon: Incipience and there were network connection issues.
 
5. Fixed an issue where the Quantum Mech Energy display sometimes glitched when she was equipped with Waxing Moon or Waxing Moon: Incipience and in Stellar Outburst.
 
6. Fixed an issue where the Combo ATK was sometimes automatically cast, then glitched and failed to deal DMG after casting Astral Ring Skill, when she was equipped with Waxing Moon or Waxing Moon: Incipience.
 
 
◆ Starry Impression
Fixed her voice lines when changing outfits.
 
 
◆ Reverist Calico
Fixed an issue where the VFX sometimes glitched after triggering evasion.
 
 
◆ Others
1. Fixed an issue where certain character models sometimes glitched after zooming in.
 
2. Fixed an issue where the transparency of certain characters' weapon skill charging displays sometimes glitched.
 
3. Optimized the overlapping mechanics of characters' impair effects under certain circumstances.
 
4. Added the Heal tag to the characters: Jovial Deception: Shadowdimmer, Valkyrie Blastmetal, Azure Empyrea, Herrscher of Rebirth, and Sugary Starburst. This is a label addition that does not affect the characters' skill effects.
 
5. Edited terminology in the skill descriptions of certain characters, weapons, and stigmata. This is only a text correction, and it does not affect the actual skill effects.
 
 
 
☆☆☆☆☆ Weapons ☆☆☆☆☆
◆ Torch of Eons and Torch of Eons: Skyfire
Fixed active skill effect: "When an enemy marked with Feather Burning Mark is hit by a Combo ATK of the corresponding stance, the Mark detonates and deals Fire DMG" as it sometimes glitched and failed to take effect.
 
 
◆ Waxing Moon and Waxing Moon: Incipience
A text correction of weapon active has been made, but it does not affect the actual weapon skill effects.
 
 
 
☆☆☆☆☆ Stigmata ☆☆☆☆☆
◆ Paganini
Fixed an issue where recommended battlesuit information was not available.
 
 
 
☆☆☆☆☆ AstralOp and ELF ☆☆☆☆☆
◆ Dreamseeker
1. Added backstories and AstralOp anecdotes unlocked with Part 2 Main Story's progress.
 
2. Fixed an issue where Astral Ring skill effects sometimes glitched and were not cast for some characters with this AstralOp.
 
 
◆ Project Bunny
Fixed an issue where the display for unlocking Astral Ring levels sometimes glitched.
 
 
 
☆☆☆☆☆ Enemies ☆☆☆☆☆
◆ Dark Bronya
Fixed an issue where the unrestricted lock-on mode sometimes glitched and she could not be locked on to in certain stages.
 
 
◆ Others
Adjusted the HP display of certain QUA-type enemies. This is just a display optimization and does not affect the actual HP values.
 
 
 
☆☆☆☆☆ Gameplay ☆☆☆☆☆
◆ Part 2 Main Story
1. Added main story map: Ruimu that can be unlocked through Part 2 Chapter VI missions.
 
2. Added a prompt for saved progress after completing certain Part 2 missions.
 
3. Optimized the display of Mei and Bronya when they are standing and interacting in the Hyperion 11 map.
 
 
◆ Part 1 Main Story
1. Fixed an issue in Story Chapter XIII where the stage scenes sometimes glitched.
 
2. Fixed an issue in Story Stage 35-5 where the scene model sometimes glitched.
 
3. Fixed an issue in Story Chapter XXXV's cinematic where the camera sometimes glitched.
 
 
◆ Open World
Fixed an issue in A Post-Honkai Odyssey Chapter 2's side story The Returned Blade where Krystallums/Krystalloids sometimes could not be claimed.
 
 
◆ Superstring Dimension
1. New stage: Resonance: Perilous, featuring Vita: Sea's Depths as the main enemy.
 
2. New stage: Inferno: Perilous, featuring Flame-Chaser: Kosma as the main enemy.
 
3. New stage: Darkness: Perilous, featuring Husk - Mysticism as the main enemy.

4. Fixed an issue in Stardust: Perilous where boss Meteroid: Epernay sometimes glitched and was unaffected by Blitzlock and Ice Cell effects.
 
5. Fixed an issue in Thunderbane: Perilous where some of boss Jade Knight's attacks glitched when locking on to targets.
 

◆ Memorial Arena
1. New SSS boss: Vita: Sea's Depths.

2. Fixed an issue where obstructions sometimes occurred during SSS-rank boss Valrahal's phase change.

3. Fixed an issue during SSS-rank boss Flame-Chaser Aponia's skill A Heart Restrained where certain characters' attacks sometimes could not parry enemies' melee attacks.

4. Fixed an issue where SSS-rank boss Sprout of Wishing sometimes fell out of the map or glitched after locking onto a character.
 
 
◆ Elysian Realm
1. New playable battlesuit: Thousand-Faced Maestro: Cameo!
 
2. Boss for Floor 17 of Deep Sequence changed to Beast of Sacrifice.
 
3. Updated the stage effects and buff effects of Deep Sequence.
 
4. Fixed an issue where the ESC hotkey sometimes did not work to return to the previous screen.
 
5. Fixed an issue in LITE Combat where buttons were not blocked after selecting a portal and caused characters to move abnormally.
 
6. Fixed an issue where support character Deepspace Anchor: First Light's support skill sometimes glitched and dealt DMG incorrectly.
 
 
◆ Realms of Battle
Fixed the special adjustments descriptions for Herrscher of Finality in Starfire Rekindled: Time Runner.
 
 
 
☆☆☆☆☆ Shop ☆☆☆☆☆
◆ Exchange House
Added weapon Keys of Oblivion, stigma set Columbus, and stigma set Shattered Swords. Weekly free refreshes adjusted to 999 times.
 
 
◆ Witch's Corridor
Herrscher of Origin Rank-up Stamp is now purchasable with Pure Witch Orbs.
 
 
◆ War Treasury
Added Herrscher of Sentience Character Card, Herrscher of Sentience Soul, Wafer Dataflow, and Wafer Stabilizer. Ancient Willpowers required to exchange for Herrscher of Reason Character Card reduced from 1120 to 900.
 
*After the v7.9 update, Ancient Willpower x220 will be issued via in-game mail to Captains who exchanged for Herrscher of Reason Character Card in War Treasury at Ancient Willpower x1120.
 
 
◆ Elysian Shop
Disciplinary Perdition Rank-Up Stamps will be available, unlocked after clearing Deep Sequence on Shroud and higher with Disciplinary Perdition.
 
 
◆ Mirage Store
Time Structure will no longer be available.
 
 
◆ Asterite Shop
Version limited-time exchange for Normal Crystal Cores and Einstein's Torus will be available. Time Structure will no longer be available.
 
*After the v7.9 update, Time Structures will be converted to Time Swirl Passes at a fixed rate. Methods for obtaining Time Structures will now reward Time Swirl Passes.
 
 
 
☆☆☆☆☆ Battle Pass ☆☆☆☆☆
1. Added the following purchasable items to BP Works:
[Rank-Up Stamp] Herrscher of Truth Rank-Up Stamp (Knight BP or Paladin BP required)
[Weapon] Twirling Glaze
[Stigmata] Exotic Lamp Stigma Set
 
2. Unlock Paladin BP to get Mirthful Skit Ribbon.
 
3. Unlock Knight BP/Paladin BP to get BP Robevyom v7.9. Open it to receive one of the following: Crimson Carol (outfit), Simply Orange (outfit), Everdream (outfit), Indelible Memories (outfit), or 8000 Asterite.
 
4. BP Arsenal token changed to Honor Chip v7.9 and Provisions Crate changed to Provisions Crate v7.9.
 
 
 
☆☆☆☆☆ System ☆☆☆☆☆
◆ Foundry
You can now craft G4 stigma set Ragna, G4 stigma set Bianka: Theatre, and Prism Stigma Sparkle: Thousand-Faced Maestro directly in Foundry.
 
 
◆ Bridge Interactions
1. Added interactive animations and voice lines for Thousand-Faced Maestro: Cameo!.
 
2. Fixed an issue where the face of Jovial Deception: Shadowdimmer's model sometimes glitched on the bridge screen.
 
 
◆ Achievements
Added the achievement for obtaining Thousand-Faced Maestro: Cameo!.
 
 
◆ System Screens
1. Additional confirmation window added after tapping the top left of the bridge to enter Main Story Part 2.
 
2. Optimized the quick access display on the top right corner of the bridge main screen.
 
3. Adjusted the preview display on v7.9's main story entrance on the prep screen. This adjustment will take effect from Part 2 Main Story Chapter VI.
 
 
◆ Quick LITE
1. Quick LITE feature added to Realms of Battle.
 
2. Fixed an issue in Armada Sim Battle where the Quick LITE feature sometimes glitched and failed to work when there were network connection issues.
 
 
◆ Mail
Fixed an issue where the number of mails sometimes glitched and displayed incorrectly.
 
 
◆ Settings
1. Fixed an issue where controller settings for Special Event sometimes could not be changed.
 
2. Fixed an issue where controller settings for the D-pad sometimes could not be changed.
 
 
◆ Device Lock System
1. Added a new device lock system that can be accessed in Account settings to protect your account. After the device lock is enabled, salvaging event gear, high-tier gear, forging/selling rare materials, or wishing for stigmata on a new device requires the device lock verification.
 
2. Added a quick unlock function to unlock equipment quickly with a device lock password.
 
*Ai-chan's Reminders:
1. When the same device performs the above actions, the correct password only needs to be entered once for a specific period of time.
 
2. If you have forgotten your device lock password, you can request to disable the password. After submitting the request, the device lock password will be disabled after 3 days and you can reset your device lock password.
 

◆ Others
1. Added the function of selecting interactive prompts with the numeric keypad for keyboard and mouse mode. For controller mode, interactive prompts can be selected with the left joystick and direction buttons, and the [LB] button can be used to confirm selections.
 
2. Added early access feature for the main story. The latest version's main story chapter can be accessed without clearing previous story missions. Main story progress can be selected at the main story entrance on the prep screen and the story chapter selection screen on the map.
 
3. Fixed an issue where the preset lineup sometimes was not displayed correctly on dialog screens.
 
4. Added stickers for some chat windows.

notes.title: Planetary Rewind Version Update Announcement
notes.content:
Welcome to v7.8: Planetary Rewind!

Update Content
★ New MECH-type S-rank battlesuit Lone Planetfarer
Lone Planetfarer is a MECH-type Lightning DMG dealer protected by Rite of Oblivion. She uses a Drive Core in battle and crushes enemies with the Star Traveler's bombardment of attacks.

*You can obtain the new battlesuit and her recommended equipment in the following ways:
1. The Battlesuit Supply Interstellar Stroll will be available. The featured S-rank battlesuit Lone Planetfarer is guaranteed in 90 drops with the first 10 drops free.

2. Equipment Supply is available for a limited time! Recommended for Lone Planetfarer: Drive Core Skyveil Feathers and Across Planets Alone stigma set drop rates UP!

3. Participate in the login event to get Across Planets Alone Stigma Option x1. Open it to receive one of Lone Planetfarer's recommended stigmata. 

4. Across Planets Alone stigma set is craftable. Forging a stigma requires Source Prism x2 and Ether Fuel x600.


★ New equipment recommended for Herrscher of Finality: Divine Key Waxing Moon and King of Conquerors stigma set
Divine Keys for Herrscher of Finality: Waxing Moon and PRI-ARM Waxing Moon: Incipience debut! When Herrscher of Finality is equipped with them, activate Astral Ring Specialization: Rite of Oblivion to change her Weapon Skill.

*You can obtain her recommended equipment in the following ways:
1. Equipment Supply available for a limited time! Herrscher of Finality's recommended equipment Divine Key Waxing Moon and King of Conquerors stigma set are available with increased drop rates!

2. Participate in the login event to get King of Conquerors Stigma Option x1. Open it to receive one of Herrscher of Finality's new recommended stigmata. 

3. King of Conquerors stigma set is craftable. Forging a stigma requires Source Prism x2 and Ether Fuel x600.


★ Limited-time Event: Starry Night Gifts! Season of Bonuses
Starry Night Gifts! Season of Bonuses begins! During the event, complete missions on the event page to get shop tokens Wishing Stars, which can be used in event shop Stardust Market to exchange for Red Autumn Foliage Option, a Prism Stigma Direct Level-Up Coupon, Honkai Shards, Einstein's Torus and more!


★ Part 2 Main Story Chapter V: The First and Last War
In the beginning, you were unaware that you were facing the end; in the end, you are fated to return to the beginning.


Play the main story to get Crystals, Source Prisms, and more. During v7.8, complete missions to obtain Perfect Partners Weapon Option and other limited-time rewards.
The event Construction? Imagination? Simulation Battle! will also be released with Part 2 Main Story Chapter V. Play the event to obtain Crystals, Source Prisms, Ancient Willpowers, and more. During v7.8, complete missions to get 4★ stigma Seele: At Leisure (M) and other limited-time rewards!


★ Featured Event: Wilderness Development Logs
After landing in an abandoned bubble universe, the struggle to survive in the wilderness begins... Hold on, what are you guys doing here?
Featured event Wilderness Development Logs begins in v7.8. Play the event to obtain Dreamweaver's new outfit Lulling Waves, Crystals, Source Prisms, and more.


★ Special Event: Carnival Spend Bonuses
Carnival Spend Bonuses available after the v7.8 update ~ 12:00, NOV 15. Spend 30000 Crystals (excluding Returnee Support) to obtain Mad Pleasure: Shadowbringer's new outfit Gentle is the Night! Spend a specific number of Crystals or equal worth of Supply Cards to obtain Carnival Annulons. Use Carnival Annulons to purchase Herrscher of Finality Character Card x1, Herrscher of Finality Rank-Up Stamp x6, Herrscher of Truth Rank-Up Stamp x6, and more at the shop!


★ Login Events: Midnight Hauntings & 10x Carnival Battlesuit Supply Cards & Petrifying Nightmares
After the v7.8 update ~ 04:00, NOV 28, log in for 8 days to claim Across Planets Alone Stigma Option, King of Conquerors Stigma Option, Crystals, and more!

12:00 OCT 19 ~ 12:00, NOV 8, log in to claim 10x Carnival Battlesuit Supply Cards x2 for v7.8's Carnival Battlesuit Supply.

04:00, OCT 22 ~ 04:00, NOV 28, log in for 7 days to claim Miracle Wings Battlesuit Option and Bold Flight Supply Option! Open Miracle Wings Battlesuit Option to receive one of the following: Silverwing: N-EX Character Card x1, Miracle ☆ Magical Girl Character Card x1, Silverwing: N-EX Rank-Up Stamp x5, Miracle ☆ Magical Girl Rank-Up Stamp x5, or Ancient Willpower x600. Open Bold Flight Supply Option to receive one of the following: Battlesuit Supply Card x5, Equipment Supply Card x5, or 1200 Crystals.


★ Featured Event Rerun: TeRiRi's Magical Quest
In pursuit of a lofty and dazzling dream, she secretly made up her mind and embarked on a journey towards miracles. Planning the route, packing her bags, gathering companions... although there were stumbling blocks along the way, she finally made it! However, the big question is whether the end of the journey would live up to her expectations...

Featured event TeRiRi's Magical Quest will be available in v7.8. Play the event to obtain Crystals, Twilight Serenade Outfit Option, Phase Shifters, Honkai Shards, and more!
*Open Twilight Serenade Outfit Option to receive one of the following: outfit Nocturne Ablaze, outfit Magic Girl TeRiRi, outfit Valkyrie Dawn, or 8000 Asterite.


★ Limited-time Event: Starry Night Treasures
10:00, NOV 14 ~ 11:59, NOV 25, complete missions on the Castle Exploration page to obtain Antique Keys and participate in the raffle! Stand a chance to win an iPad Air, AirPods, an Xbox Wireless Controller, and more!


★ Permanent LITE Features

notes.title: v7.7 Drudging, Drifting, Dreaming Update Announcement
notes.content:
★ New QUA-type S-rank Battlesuit Schicksal's Imperative
Schicksal's Imperative is a QUA-type Lightning DMG dealer who wields chained blades. When she's serious about work, her puppets, Off-Work HOMU and On-Vacay HOMU, will strive hard with her to knock off swiftly. She wears her eye mask and falls asleep when she wants to slack off. As for her unfinished tasks... she'll let her diligent puppets fight on her behalf!

*You can obtain the new battlesuit and her recommended equipment in the following ways:
1. Sleepy Wishes Battlesuit Supply is available. The featured S-rank battlesuit Schicksal's Imperative is guaranteed in 90 drops with 50% off the first 10 drops.

2. Equipment Supply is available for a limited time. Recommended for Schicksal's Imperative: Chained Blades Vacation Notice and Day After Day stigma set drop rates UP!

3. Vacation Signal event is available! Log in for 7 days to obtain Day After Day Stigma Option x1, 120 Crystals, 2800 Asterite, and AE Imaginon x5. Open Day After Day Stigma Option to choose from one of Schicksal's Imperative's recommended stigmata.

4. Day After Day stigma set is craftable. Forging a stigma requires Source Prism x2 and Ether Fuel x600.


★ Featured Event Born From A Dream
As a Fixer, you go about your day resolving problems. But reality starts to crumble when a mysterious person named Vita appears...

Defend your mind from nightmares with Vita's help! Event rewards Chrono Navi's new outfit Guiding Star, Feathery Dreams Emblem, Crystals, Source Prisms, and more.


★ Part 2 Main Story Chapter IV: A Shore Under Watch
Who is the ocean, and who am I?
I shall find the answer after the world ends.

In v7.7, new story chapter A Shore Under Watch will be available. Play the main story and the event Investigation? Theresa's Great Adventure to claim Dreamseeker Chips to upgrade Dreamseeker, Crystals, Source Prisms, Ancient Willpowers, and more.


★ Limited-time Top-up Bonuses: Starry Wishes
During the event, accumulate top-ups to claim Weapon Direct Level-Up Coupons, Herrscher of Truth/Herrscher of Human: Ego Rank-Up Stamps, Source Prisms, Supply Cards, Boosters, and more bonuses!


★ Limited-Time Event Schicksal's Vacation
During the event, play login events, the main story, featured events, and more to obtain Vacation Tickets. On the event page, use Vacation Tickets to sweep Adventure Tasks, Universal Mirage, and Weekly Quiz for immediate event rewards.


★ Hyperion Arsenal
New Weapons: Chained Blades Vacation Notice; PRI Chained Blades Vacation Notice: Emergency Overtime

New Stigmata: Day After Day Stigma Set

notes.title: v7.6 Fading Dreams, Dimming Shadows Update Announcement
notes.content:
Let's write the future on gold leaves together.


Update Content
★ New SD-type S-rank battlesuit Jovial Deception: Shadowdimmer
Jovial Deception: Shadowdimmer is an SD-type battlesuit. She uses a new weapon called the Trick Staff to deal Physical DMG. In her usual form, she casts splendid ranged attacks. In Stellar Outburst, she will transform herself behind screens and enter the battlefield in a new form.

Event Gifts of Gratitude begins at 10:00, JUL 27. Log in to obtain Songque's gift, which grants Battlesuit Supply Card x5.


※ You can obtain the new battlesuit and her recommended equipment in the following ways:
After the v7.6 update, you can participate in the Battlesuit Supply Leaf of Gold to obtain Jovial Deception: Shadowdimmer, with 50% off the first 10x drops.

Equipment Supply will also be available! Recommended for Jovial Deception: Shadowdimmer: Trick Staff Purge of Ten Faces and Leaf's Visions stigma set drop rates UP!


★ Part 2 Main Story Chapter III Interlude: Bitterness for a Sleepwalker
The one dreaming was awoken by the person she dreamt of in her dream.

Explore the main story and complete specific missions to get Crystals, Source Prisms, Phase Shifters, and more.


★ Featured Event Schicksal Work Guide
Nurture the perfect employee to escape endless work!

Featured event Schicksal Work Guide coming soon in v7.6! Play to get Terminal Aide 0017's new outfit Fizzy Ray, Crystals, and more!


★ Special Event Shop Fortune Mall
Event shop Fortune Mall opens. During the event, Captains can participate in Supply events and purchase themed bundles to obtain event shop tokens, Better Luck. Better Luck tokens can be used to obtain Cosmic Expression's outfit Gokudo Brushstrokes, Divine Key Option, Collector's Card, Equipment Supply Cards, Source Prisms, and more.


★ Login Event Carefree Wanders
During the event, log in 7 days to get Leaf's Visions Stigma Option, Crystals, and more. Open Leaf's Visions Stigma Option to choose from one of Jovial Deception: Shadowdimmer's recommended stigmata.


★ Limited-Time Event Schicksal's Vacation
During the event, play the main story, featured events, and more to obtain Vacation Tickets. On the event page, use Vacation Tickets to sweep Adventure Tasks, Universal Mirage, and Weekly Quiz for immediate event rewards.


★ New Event Powered Duo
In v7.6, new event Powered Duo will be available. Play stage challenges to gain points and obtain HOMU Duo Unity Emblem, Source Prisms, SC Metal-H2, Einstein's Torus, and more.


★ Elysian Realm Event Deep Sequence: Performance Test
During the event, Deep Sequence: Performance Test counts as Deep Sequence on Corruption Difficulty. Captains must clear 7 challenges with specified characters to obtain milestone rewards and stage-clear rewards in Deep Sequence.


★ Hyperion Arsenal
New weapon type Trick Staff added.

New Weapons: Trick Staffs Purge of Ten Faces, Fair Judgment, and Branched Ending; PRI-ARM Trick Staff Purge of Ten Faces: Axial Shift

New Stigmata: Leaf's Visions Stigma Set



Game Adjustments & Optimizations
☆☆☆☆☆ Battlesuits ☆☆☆☆☆
The following data are at max skill level:

◆ Lone Destruction: Shadowchaser
1. Fixed an issue where the weapon model sometimes disappeared on the upgrade screen when she was put on bridge duty.

2. Fixed an issue where the submachine gun sometimes glitched and still fired even after Hypothermia hit the threshold and she was sealed in Ice Cell.

4. Fixed an issue where she sometimes gained Concentrated Blast Energy when entering Stellar Outburst after activating an Astral Ring that was not Wheel of Destiny.

5. Fixed an issue where the switching of characters sometimes glitched and she did not leave the field after another character was switched in.

6. Fixed an issue where the submachine gun's firing sound effects sometimes glitched and continued playing on the Pause Menu.

7. Fixed an issue where her shadow sometimes glitched in Antares Building, Oxia in Part 2's main story.

8. Adjusted some effects of Astral Ring Skill Dazzling Brilliance: When Shadow Star Attack is cast, "she has Iron Body" is changed to "she is invincible". Other skill effects are not affected.

9. Edited Evasion Skill description to "A successful Ultimate Leap triggers Ultimate Evasion Skill." This is only a text correction, and it does not affect the actual skill effects.


◆ Mad Pleasure: Shadowbringer

2. Fixed an issue where weapon skill effects sometimes glitched when weapon skills were cast.

3. Fixed an issue where Phantom attacks sometimes got wrongly interrupted by evasions.

4. Fixed an issue where she sometimes appeared at the wrong place on the bridge.

5. Optimized the animations when switching between ATKs and Ultimates, and when entering Stellar Outburst.

6. Edited Evasion Skill description to "A successful Ultimate Leap triggers Ultimate Evasion Skill." This is only a text correction, and it does not affect the actual skill effects.


◆ Deepspace Anchor: First Light

5. Fixed an issue where the model sometimes glitched in some stages.

6. New special effect name Prismatic Stars added for skill Custom Module: Radon: "When the character enters battle, on-field characters deal 10% bonus Total DMG and 60% bonus Physical DMG, while enemies take 25% bonus Physical DMG from them. During Stellar Outburst, on-field characters deal 30% bonus Total DMG, which is removed by Deepspace Anchor: First Light's entry." This is only a text correction, and it does not affect the actual skill effects.


◆ Valkyrie Blastmetal
Edited the skill description of special ATK Combo ATK: Slightly Hitting Harder such that Stellar Drain is only consumed during Astral Ring Charging. This is only a text correction, and it does not affect the actual effects.

New special effect name Crit Conversion added for skill Dawning Light That Strides Across the Dark: "With Crit Rate lower than 100%, every 2% of Crit DMG (up to 50%) is converted to 1% of Crit Rate until Crit Rate reaches 100%." This is only a text correction, and it does not affect the actual skill effects.

2. New stage: Purgatory: Perilous, featuring Meteoroid: Guaymas as the main enemy.

☆☆☆☆☆ Starter's Manual ☆☆☆☆☆

8. Source Prism missions added. When Starter's Manual is available, Training Plan missions can be completed to obtain up to Source Prism x21.

2. New "Story Auto-Play" function added and will be enabled by default. It can be enabled or disabled in Settings - Other Settings.

6. In BP Missions, dispatching expeditions count toward the daily story stage mission.

7. Improved the situation of power usage and heating of iPhone 15 devices.

8. Fixed an issue where weapon color sometimes glitched on the Valkyrie screen.

9. Optimized the Japanese voice lines for Astral Ring Character Mad Pleasure: Shadowbringer: Fixed issues with the Japanese voice lines during the fortune-telling scene in Antares Building.

notes.title: v7.5 Crusade of Chasing Shadows Update Announcement
notes.content:
If fear emanated by humans summons shadows, the convergence of fear from shadows makes "Lantern" blaze bright.

Update Content
★ New PSY-type S-rank Battlesuit Lone Destruction: Shadowchaser
Lone Destruction: Shadowchaser is a PSY-type battlesuit dealing Fire DMG with a Rapid-Shot Crossbow. She switches between three different weapons quickly and bombards enemies with attacks using vestiges. No enemy will survive the Lone Destruction: Shadowchaser's rapid attacks.

*You can obtain the new battlesuit and her recommended equipment in the following ways:
After the v7.5 update, you can participate in the Battlesuit Supply Iridescent Glow to obtain Lone Destruction: Shadowchaser, with 50% off the first 10x drops.

Meanwhile, Lone Destruction: Shadowchaser's recommended Equipment Supply will also be available, with increased drop rates for Rapid-Shot Crossbow Burn the Long Night and A Forged Light stigma set!


★ Part 2 Main Story Chapter III: A Crime Foretold
Today's landscape feels like a repeat of yesterday's. They can't alter their destiny any more than they can change who they are.

During v7.5, explore the main story and complete specific missions to get Crystals, Source Prisms, Ancient Willpowers and more.


★ Featured Event: Lantern Against Shadows
In the distant past, people would always light up lanterns to drive away the fear in the shadows.
Featured event Lantern Against Shadows kicks off! Participate in the event to claim Miracle ☆ Magical Girl's new outfit Magic Academy Uniform, Crystals, Source Prisms and more!


★ Login Event
During v7.5, accumulate daily logins to claim A Forged Light Stigma Option, Equipment Supply Cards and more. Open A Forged Light Stigma Option to choose from one of Lone Destruction: Shadowchaser's recommended stigmata.


★ Limited-time Top-up Bonuses: Starry Wishes
During v7.5, accumulate top-ups and reach a specified amount of B-Chips or Crystals to obtain Weapon Direct Level-Up Coupons, Herrscher of Human: Ego/Disciplinary Perdition Rank-up Stamps, Source Prisms and more!


★ Outfit Shop: Till Death Do Us Part
Lunar Vow: Crimson Love's outfit Till Death Do Us Part will be available for a limited time in the Outfit Shop at a discounted price of 1680 B-Chips in its launch week!


★ Hyperion Arsenal
New weapons: Rapid-Shot Crossbow Burn the Long Night, PRI-ARM Rapid-Shot Crossbow Burn the Long Night: Luminare

New stigmata: A Forged Light set

notes.title: v7.4 Invitation To The Mad Banquet Update Announcement
notes.content:
Raise your glass at her command — representing your participation in this mad banquet!

Update Content
★ New MECH-type S-rank Battlesuit Mad Pleasure: Shadowbringer
Mad Pleasure: Shadowbringer is a MECH-type Ice DMG dealer. With a diverse range of techniques and a whimsical combat style, she keeps her foes on their toes. After casting Ultimate, she traps enemies in a cage of chained blades for a lethal strike.

*You can obtain the new battlesuit and her recommended equipment in the following ways:
After the v7.4 update, you can participate in the Battlesuit Supply Dancing With Shadows to obtain Mad Pleasure: Shadowbringer, with 50% off the first 10x drops.

Meanwhile, Mad Pleasure: Shadowbringer's recommended Equipment Supply will also be available, with increased drop rates for Chained Blades Banquet Rose, and Splendors of Amber stigma set.


★ Part 2 Main Story Chapter II: The Seven Shus in the Maze
Led by Songque, they embarked on a journey to Tombstone Library and Masquerade Corridor, hoping to awaken the dormant Shu. Meanwhile, a bullet was silently loaded...

Explore the main story and complete specific missions to get Crystals, Source Prisms, Ancient Willpowers, Phase Shifters and more.


★ Character Event: Banquet Dance of Shade
To learn the Shus' secrets, they will have to unravel a century-old memory...

Banquet Dance of Shade Phase 2 is available. Play the event and complete specific missions to get Crystals, Honkai Shards, Phase Shifters, Ancient Willpowers, ADV Skill Materials and more!


★ Featured event: Flying to Oxia Invitation Contest
If I ever stand on the field and compete for the championship, I'll undoubtedly play the most remarkable game of my life, welcoming the fireworks reserved for the victor.

Flying to Oxia Invitation Contest will be released in v7.4. Play the event to get Sugary Starburst's new outfit Fuzzy Pink Love, emblem The Top of Oxia Trophy, Crystals, Source Prisms, Honkai Shards and more!


★ Bonuses Event: Back to Your Roots
Complete 4 of the 6 event missions to get Herrscher of Origin Character Card.


★ Login Event: Banquet Invitation
During the event, log in 7 days to get Splendors of Amber Stigma Option, Crystals and more. Open Splendors of Amber Stigma Option to choose from one of Mad Pleasure: Shadowbringer's recommended stigmata.


★ Outfit Supply: Mountainous White Feather
During v7.4, you can pull drops in the Outfit Supply Mountainous White Feather to obtain the featured outfit (Fenghuang of Vicissitude's outfit Crane of Taixuan) in 10 drops (costs 9600 Crystals).


★ More Outfits
