notes.title: v7.3 Dreamseeking Voyage Update Announcement
notes.content:
"Hey there, world!" This girl, born from the Sea of Data, is super curious about everything around her. On the journey of pursuing dreams, she will accompany you to experience all sorts of adventures and meet a bunch of interesting folks. By the way, if she swings by late at night, make sure to treat her to some barbecue.

New S-rank battlesuit Deepspace Anchor: First Light, and A-rank battlesuits Valkyrie Boltstorm and Valkyrie Blastmetal debut together!

Login event In the New Chapter of Time, Another Journey Begins on the Anniversary is available. Log in to get the recommended Into the Universe stigma set (level maxed) for Valkyrie Blastmetal, the Anniversary Commemorative Stigma: Senadina: Departure (B), and Equipment Supply Card x10.

Part 2 main story Chapter I Hundred Years of Solitary Shadow is available. Play the story to get Valkyrie Blastmetal Character Card, 4★ weapon Blast Hammer: Blazing Red, 4★ event stigma, Crystals, Ancient Assist Gift Box 2024, Growth Assist Gift Box 2024, Valkyrie Boltstorm Fragments, Valkyrie Blastmetal Fragments, Anniversary Frame Gift Box and more.

Featured event A Feast Sought in Data will also be available in v7.3. Play the event to get Disciplinary Perdition's new outfit Butterfly Dreams, Dark Berry Fantasy Emblem, Crystals, Valkyrie Boltstorm Fragments, Valkyrie Blastmetal Fragments, and more.

Bonuses Event Source Research List begins. Complete event missions and exchange in the event shop Research Supply Division to get up to Source Prism x42.


Update Content
★ New S-rank Battlesuit Deepspace Anchor: First Light Debuts
Deepspace Anchor: First Light is an SD-type battlesuit that deals Lightning DMG. She wields a new weapon type, Drive Core, to fight on the ground and in the air by unleashing various Thunderous Strikes.


★ New A-rank Battlesuit Valkyrie Boltstorm Debuts
Valkyrie Boltstorm is a MECH-type support battlesuit that deals Lightning DMG. Valkyrie Boltstorm wields a new weapon type, Rapid-Shot Crossbow, to shoot enemies rapidly.


★ New A-rank Battlesuit Valkyrie Blastmetal Debuts
Valkyrie Blastmetal is a PSY-type battlesuit that has an Astral Ring protected by the Rite of Oblivion. Valkyrie Blastmetal wields a new weapon type, Rocket Hammer, to deal Fire DMG and inflict Vulnerability on enemies while providing buffs to teammates.

※ You can obtain the new battlesuits and their recommended equipment in the following ways:
◆ Obtaining Battlesuits/Fragments
After the v7.3 update, participate in the Battlesuit Supply Hello, Mars! to obtain Deepspace Anchor: First Light, Valkyrie Boltstorm, and Valkyrie Blastmetal.

Additionally, after the v7.3 update, play Part 2 main story Chapter I Hundred Years of Solitary Shadow to obtain Valkyrie Blastmetal Character Card, and complete certain Open World Adventure Tasks to get Valkyrie Blastmetal Fragments.

Participate in the events during v7.3 to get Valkyrie Boltstorm Fragments and Valkyrie Blastmetal Fragments.

◆ Obtaining Weapons/Stigmata
After the v7.3 update, the Recommended Equipment Supply for Deepspace Anchor: First Light and Valkyrie Boltstorm will be available. The UP equipment in Equipment Supply A are Deepspace Anchor: First Light's recommended weapon Red Star Thunderbolt and the Perfect Morning Stigma Set: Helia: Joy (T), Senadina: Scenery (M), Coralie: Piano (B). The UP equipment in Equipment Supply B are Valkyrie Boltstorm's recommended weapon Electrifying Arc and the Genius Pioneer Stigma Set: Von Neumann (T, M, B).

Valkyrie Blastmetal's recommended weapon and recommended stigma set (level maxed) are respectively obtainable in Part 2 main story Chapter I: Hundred Years of Solitary Shadow and the login event In the New Chapter of Time, Another Journey Begins on the Anniversary.

The exclusive Modification Parts for the recommended weapons of Valkyrie Boltstorm and Valkyrie Blastmetal will be available in the Asterite Shop. You can craft 4 Modification Parts into 1 Modification Box. Complete Synergy for weapons with corresponding exclusive Modification Boxes.


★ Part 2 Main Story Chapter I: Hundred Years of Solitary Shadow
"Under this starry sky, the world has long been dead, and civilization reduced to nothing but a mere illusion. Despite all of that, you still wish to seek your own future, do you not?"

Part 2 main story Chapter I Hundred Years of Solitary Shadow is coming with a new exploration mode and challenge mode in v7.3. Play the main story and complete specific missions to get Valkyrie Blastmetal Character Card, 4★ Rocket Hammer weapon Blast Hammer: Blazing Red, 4★ event stigma Songque: Fear Gathering (M), Crystals, Ancient Assist Gift Box 2024, Growth Assist Gift Box 2024, Valkyrie Boltstorm Fragments, Valkyrie Blastmetal Fragments, Energy Devices, and more.


★ Login Event: In the New Chapter of Time, Another Journey Begins on the Anniversary
"Depart again for a new, uncharted destination."

Log in to get the recommended stigma set Into the Universe (level maxed) for Valkyrie Blastmetal, the Anniversary Commemorative Stigma: Senadina: Departure (B), and Equipment Supply Card x10.


★ Featured Event: A Feast Sought in Data
Exploring the wondrous food ingredients and dangerous illusions in the Sea of Data... That's not really a holiday internship, right?

Featured event A Feast Sought in Data will be available in v7.3. Help Sweet run the diner, gather food ingredients, innovate recipes, serve delicious food to the customers, and improve the diner's culinary rating. Play the event to get Disciplinary Perdition's new outfit Butterfly Dreams, Dark Berry Fantasy Emblem, Crystals, Valkyrie Boltstorm Fragments, Valkyrie Blastmetal Fragments, and more.


★ Featured Event: Spring Fireworks Show
Sharing laughs and good times, we reminisce about the treasured past and eagerly await a bright future.

Featured event Spring Fireworks Show begins, and the new modes HOMU World Spring Challenge Tournament and Lucky Fountain are available in v7.3! Play the event to get Crystals, Growth Assist Gift Box 2024, Beady Fireworks Box 2024, Valkyrie Boltstorm Fragments, Valkyrie Blastmetal Fragments, and more.


★ Bonuses Event: Source Research List
"Research tasks... there are so many unfinished ones."

During the event, log in and play Part 2 main story Chapter I Hundred Years of Solitary Shadow, featured event A Feast Sought in Data, and exchange in the event shop Research Supply Division to get up to Source Prism x42.


★ Anniversary Spend Bonuses
Spend Crystals in Supply events to get Eternal Evening Stars and exchange them for Disciplinary Perdition Character Card, Disciplinary Perdition Rank-up Stamps, Helical Contraption Rank-up Stamps, Valkyrie Boltstorm Fragments, Valkyrie Blastmetal Fragments, S-rank ELF Parts, and more!

Spend 30000 Crystals in Supply events to get Jade Knight's new outfit Midnight Moon!



★ Additions to the Hyperion Arsenal
◆ New Weapons: Drive Core weapons Red Star Thunderbolt, The Value of Pi, Rapid-Shot Crossbow weapons Electrifying Arc, Ta-da! The Blow, Rocket Hammer weapons Blast Hammer: Blazing Red, Calm Baby, and PRI-ARMs Red Star Thunderbolt: Breaking Dawn and Electrifying Arc: Azure Sky.

◆ New Stigmata: stigma sets Perfect Morning, Genius Pioneer, Into the Universe, and stigma Senadina: Departure (B)


★ Additions to the Dressing Room
◆ Miracle ☆ Magical Girl's outfit Soaring Wings

◆ Jade Knight's outfit Midnight Moon

◆ Disciplinary Perdition's outfit Butterfly Dreams



Game Adjustments & Optimizations
☆☆☆☆☆ Characters ☆☆☆☆☆
The following data are at max skill level:
◆ Fenghuang of Vicissitude
1. New QTE entry voice lines for her Kick Stance.

2. Optimized her stage finalization voice lines.

3. Fixed an issue where her animations sometimes glitched after casting Ultimate or switching to another character.

4. Fixed an issue where the VFX sometimes glitched on certain devices when casting her Ultimate Eruption That Churns Tides and Clouds.

5. Fixed an issue where her standby animations glitched in the contrast preview on the Settings screen when she was put on bridge duty.

6. Fixed an issue where her voice lines glitched after picking up items in a stage.

7. A text correction of her Shine Upon Million Years skill's short description has been made, and it does not affect the actual skill effects.

8. A text correction of her Combo ATK Awaiting Dawn in the Long Night's description has been made, and it does not affect the actual skill effects.


◆ Cosmic Expression
Fixed an issue where some of her Japanese voice lines were missing.


◆ Lunar Vow: Crimson Love
Fixed an issue where casting her Ultimate may cause enemy models to glitch.


◆ Herrscher of Finality
1. Fixed an issue where her model sometimes glitched on the bridge screen.

2. Fixed an issue where her wing model sometimes glitched on the lineup screen.


◆ Reverist Calico

◆ Palatinus Equinox
Adjusted some of her voiced interactions.


◆ Black Nucleus
Fixed an issue where the screen sometimes glitched when she cast weapon skill Total Coverage upon entering battle with Star Destroyer 19C-X equipped.

◆ Battlesuit Rule Adjustment
Increased the number of returned Fragments/Souls when obtaining a duplicate S-rank Battlesuit from "30/70" to "50/150." Please refer to Part 2 Development Special Mars Newsletter for more details.



☆☆☆☆☆ Weapons ☆☆☆☆☆
◆ Weapon Synergy Mechanics
New Weapon Synergy Mechanics:
1. New 4★ weapons released after v7.3 will have Synergy mechanics and start at Synergy Rank 1. You can consume up to 2 of the same weapon to enhance it to Synergy Rank 3.

2. New 4★ weapons have Synergy Skills. Increase your Synergy Rank to enhance the Synergy Skills.

3. For weapons with Synergy mechanics, you can only consume those weapons to forge them into PRI-ARMs.

4. Consume the corresponding Modification Boxes to complete Synergy for the recommended weapons of new A-rank battlesuits.


◆ Divine Keys
Adjusted the ways of upgrading Divine Keys Judgment of Shamash, Jizo Mitama, Grips of Tai Xuan, Cleaver of Shamash, and Star of Eden. Soulium will no longer be used for upgrading.

*After the v7.3 update, Soulium will be converted to Coins in a certain ratio.



☆☆☆☆☆ AstralOp/ELF ☆☆☆☆☆
◆ AstralOp System
1. New AstralOp System. After reaching Lv. 30, you can unlock the AstralOp System and get S-rank AstralOp Dreamseeker.

2. New S-rank AstralOp Songque, which can be obtained from AstralOp Supply.

3. AstralOp System Details:
A. When the leader has Astral Ring, an AstralOp can be assigned (or an ELF can be assigned to the team as an AstralOp). If the leader doesn't have Astral Ring, only an ELF can be assigned.

B. After activating Astral Ring in battle, AstralOp will enter to attack and further enhance the buffs provided by Astral Ring.

C. Added Astral Ring Skills to ELFs. Adjusted the upgrade material to unlock Astral Ring Skills from Mind Stones to Operation Terminals. The Mind Stones you own will be converted to Operation Terminals at a 1:1 ratio.


◆ Other Changes
1. Lowered the required level for the ELF System, allowing you to unlock ELF Jingwei's Wings at Lv. 30.

2. Removed the entrance to ELF Book of Fuxi and Bella Trial Stages.



☆☆☆☆☆ Stigmata ☆☆☆☆☆
1. New stigma type, Prism Stigma, which is the recommended stigma for all battlesuits released after the v7.3 update. Prism Stigmata can be forged, and there will be an adjustment to the materials and number of materials required for upgrades. Salvaging a Prism Stigma grants Source Prism x1. The stigmata released before v7.3 and their corresponding materials and number of materials required for upgrades will remain unchanged.

2. Adjusted the effects of some stigma affixes:
A. Adjusted "Javelin users gain bonus ATK" to "Javelin and Drive Core users gain bonus ATK".

B. Adjusted "Heavy and Scythe Wielders gain bonus ATK" to "Cannon, Scythe, and Rocket Hammer users gain bonus ATK".

C. Adjusted "Lance and Pistol Wielders gain bonus ATK" to "Pistols, Lance, and Crossbow users gain bonus ATK".



☆☆☆☆☆ Enemies ☆☆☆☆☆
◆ Flame-Chaser - Kalpas
Fixed an issue where his Fire DMG resistance didn't take effect.


◆ Huodou
1. Fixed an issue where its skill judgment sometimes glitched.

2. Added the skill Nothing but Trouble to Huodou for Superstring Dimension's Bloodbane: Perilous and Memorial Arena's SS difficulty and below. Skill Description: Huodou has higher Ignite Resist but takes more Total DMG when frozen or bleeding. This new skill is merely additional information for Huodou's mechanics and does not affect Huodou's actual stats.


◆ Alien Guard - Purification
Lowered the enemy's movement distance when casting some skills.



☆☆☆☆☆ Gameplay ☆☆☆☆☆
◆ Astral Ring Battle Mechanics
New Astral Ring Battle Mechanics:
1. The new battlesuits released after the v7.3 update will have the Astral Ring System, and they can charge the Astral Ring through various methods. When fully charged, Astral Ring will be activated to let the team enter a special enhanced state.

2. When a battlesuit with Astral Ring is assigned as the leader, the team will activate the Astral Ring System.

3. Added a display of Astral Ring Specialization, Astral Ring Attribute, and Astral Ring Skill in the Valkyrie System.

4. Added Astral Ring lineup tips to the lineup screen, which is triggered when a battlesuit with Astral Ring is assigned as the leader.


◆ Realms of Battle
1. Fixed an issue where the event lineup sometimes glitched in some stages and incorrectly carried over the main story's lineup.

2. Fixed an issue where the number of challenge objectives sometimes glitched in Extreme Trial stages.

3. Fixed an issue where the trial character display in stages was affected by the trial character toggle in Armada's Sim Battle.


◆ Elysian Realm
1. New playable battlesuits: Deepspace Anchor: First Light, Valkyrie Boltstorm, and Valkyrie Blastmetal.

2. New boss HOMU Magician for Floor 17 of Deep Sequence.

3. New support Valkyrie Deepspace Anchor: First Light.

4. Updated the stage effects and buff effects of Deep Sequence.

5. Adjusted the effects of some Signets of Infinity, and added new Astral Ring and AstralOp buff effects.

6. New charging method for the Active Skill of Boundless Logos (Remembrance Sigil): Gain 100 Charge when using Astral Ring after entering combat. CD: 4s.

7. A text correction of Signet of Setsuna's description has been made, and it does not affect the Signet's actual effects.

8. Fixed an issue in Elysian Realm where an error in the Punch Stance's Basic ATK sequence may occur when Fenghuang of Vicissitude was carrying the exclusive Signets Blessing of Attainment and Blessing of Arcane Traces.

9. Adjusted the Collection's resistance information on Husk - Nihilius in Deep Sequence Floor 17 from "no special resistance" to "Physical Resist (L)".

10. Adjusted the Collection's resistance information on Parvati in Deep Sequence Floor 17 from "Ice Resist (H), Fire Vulnerability (L)" to "Ice Resist (H), Fire Vulnerability (M)".


◆ Superstring Dimension
1. New stage: SD: Perilous, featuring Meteoroid: Guaymas as the main enemy.

2. New stage: SD: Perilous, featuring Eclipse: Suspended Eye and Eclipse: Greedy Crystalline as the main enemies.

3. New stage: Sparkle: Perilous, featuring Eclipse: Suspended Eye, Jun-Ninja, and Alien Guard - Purification as the main enemies.

5. Fixed an issue in Bloodlust: Perilous where HOMU Magicians sometimes erroneously summoned Mini HOMUs before the countdown ended.

7. Fixed an issue in Superstring Dimension's Inferno: Perilous (featuring Herrscher of the Rimestar as the main enemy) where the buff stacks were sometimes incorrect after breaking the Ice Stars on the field.

8. Fixed an issue in Superstring Dimension where boss Dominator of Wolves may be impossible to lock onto during its phase change.

9. Adjusted the Collection's resistance and strategy information on enemies in Superstring Dimension, but it does not affect the actual resistance of enemies.

● Adjusted the Collection's resistance information on boss MHT-3B Nirvana in Headhunt: Perilous from "no special resistance" to "Ice Resist (L), Lightning Resist (L)".

● Adjusted the Collection's resistance information on boss Dominator of Wolves in Purgatory: Perilous from "no special resistance" to "Ice Immunity".

● Adjusted the Collection's resistance information on boss Husk - Nihilius in Nemesis: Perilous from "no special resistance" to "Physical Resist (L)".

● Adjusted the Collection's resistance information on boss Tonatiuh: Sunshade in Quantum: Perilous from "no special resistance" to "Physical Resist (L)".

● Adjusted the Collection's resistance information on boss Herrscher of the Void in Frosthelm: Perilous from "Physical Resist (H), Lightning Resist (H)" to "Physical Resist (H), Lightning Immunity".

● Adjusted the Collection's resistance information on boss Benares in Concerto: Perilous from "no special resistance" to "Physical Resist (H)".

● Adjusted the Collection's resistance information on boss Flame-Chaser - Aponia in Dominance: Perilous from "Fire Resist (M), Lightning Resist (M), Ice Resist (M)" to "Fire Resist (H), Lightning Resist (H), Ice Resist (H)".

● Adjusted the Collection's resistance information on boss Husk - Nihilius in Frosthelm: Perilous from "no special resistance" to "Physical Resist (H)", and added a new Disadvantaged Feature: Physical.

● Adjusted the Collection's resistance information on boss Jizo Mitama in Dominance: Perilous from "Fire Resist (H), Lightning Resist (H), Ice Resist (H)" to "Fire Resist (H), Lightning Resist (H), Ice Resist (H), Physical Resist (M)".

● Adjusted the Collection's resistance information on Parvati in Nemesis: Perilous from "Ice Immunity" to "Ice Immunity, Physical Resist (L)".

● Adjusted the Collection's resistance information on boss Jade Knight in Thunderbane: Perilous from "no special resistance" to "Ice Resist (H), Physical Resist (M)", and added a new Advantaged Feature: Paralyze; and a new Disadvantaged Feature: Ice DMG.


◆ Q-Manifold
Added new enemies in the Unsteady State environment: In Elites and Masters, the enemy on Floor 10 of Sinful rank and Floor 7 of Agony rank is now Alien Guard - Purification; the enemy on Floor 10 of Redlotus rank is now Alien Guard - Supplement.


◆ Memorial Arena
1. New SSS-rank boss Meteoroid: Guaymas.

2. Fixed an issue where SSS-rank boss Flame-Chaser - Aponia's skill Claim Your Penalties, Please didn't deal damage correctly to the target.

3. Fixed an issue where SSS-rank boss HoD Minion's attack animations sometimes glitched during phase change.

4. Fixed an issue where SSS-rank boss Jizo Mitama may be impossible to lock onto during its phase change.

5. New Advantaged Feature for SSS-rank boss Parvati in the Collection — Ignite, but it does not affect the enemy's actual resistance.

6. New Disadvantaged Feature for SSS-rank boss Husk - Nihilius in the Collection — Physical, but it does not affect the enemy's actual resistance.


◆ Co-op
Removed the Co-op mode. If you have not received your Divine Key rewards, they are available from Realms of Battle. Missions associated with Co-op can now be completed at the Realms of Battle.


◆ Universal Mirage
1. Removed the co-op function in Universal Mirage.

2. New normal weapon types available for forging in Foundry: Drive Core, Rapid-Shot Crossbow, and Rocket Hammer.

3. New direct forging methods in Foundry for the stigmata recommended for Deepspace Anchor: First Light, Valkyrie Boltstorm, and Valkyrie Blastmetal.


◆ Main Story
New cost system for Daily Side stages of main story Chapter XIX Into Earth Does the Water Flow.


◆ Open World
1. Added Valkyrie Boltstorm Fragments and Valkyrie Blastmetal Fragments to Adventure Task rewards.

2. Adjusted the required level to unlock Open World: APHO and APHO Chapter 2. They are now unlocked at Lv. 40, and Sakura Samsara is now unlocked at Lv. 50.
*Captains who have unlocked these Open World modes before the v7.3 update will not be affected.

3. Removed Jingwei's Wings Parts and Blood Embrace Parts from Adventure Task rewards.
*Adventure Tasks accepted before the v7.3 update will not be affected.

4. Fixed an issue where Code IX - The Hermit's model animations glitched upon death in APHO Chapter 2.


◆ Material Expedition
Removed the Jingwei's Wings stage from Expedition. Unclaimed Crystals from challenge objectives will be delivered to your mailbox.



☆☆☆☆☆ Supply ☆☆☆☆☆
1. Adjusted the names of Expansion Supply Card, Expansion Supply, and Focused Supply Card to Battlesuit Supply Card, Battlesuit Supply, and Equipment Supply Card respectively.

2. Adjusted the obtention level for UP equipment in Supply events. UP equipment will now be at Lv. 1 instead of Lv. 10 when obtained.

3. Lowered the drop count for the guarantee of obtaining S-rank battlesuits in Battlesuit Supply to 90.

4. Removed Essentines from Battlesuit Supply and Fragment/Soul drops of various Supply events.

5. Removed Battlesuit Shard mechanics and added Stardust Shard mechanics. The Battlesuit Shards you own will be converted to Stardust Shards at a 9:1 ratio.

6. Adjusted some mechanics in Dorm Supply:
A. Removed Battlesuit Fragment/Soul drops and added Midnight Absinthe Character Card and Asterite drops.

B. Adjusted Dorm Supply's secondary drops to Stardust Shards, receive Stardust Shard x3 from each Dorm Supply.

C. New Stardust Shard conversion mechanic, duplicates of fully ranked up A-rank or S-rank battlesuits will be converted to Stardust Shards.


7. Adjusted some mechanics in Starter Special Valkyrie Supply:
A. Removed Battlesuit Fragment/Soul drops.

B. Adjusted Starter Special Valkyrie Supply's secondary drops to Stardust Shards, receive Stardust Shard x5 from each Special Valkyrie Supply.

C. New Stardust Shard conversion mechanic, duplicates of fully ranked up A-rank or S-rank battlesuits will be converted to Stardust Shards.


8. Adjusted some mechanics in Starter Special Equipment Supply:
Adjusted Starter Special Equipment Supply's secondary drops to Stardust Shards, receive Stardust Shard x5 from each Special Equipment Supply.




☆☆☆☆☆ Shop ☆☆☆☆☆
◆ War Treasury
Added Azure Empyrea Character Card, Herrscher of Thunder Character Card, Azure Empyrea Soul, Herrscher of Thunder Soul, and more.


◆ Supply Shop
1. Adjusted the shop's tokens from Battlesuit Shards to Stardust Shards.

2. Added Herrscher of Human: Ego Rank-up Stamp, Palatinus Equinox Rank-up Stamp, Source Prism, and more.


◆ Witch's Corridor
Adjusted the purchasable items with Witch Orbs from A-rank and B-rank Valkyrie Fragments to Valkyrie Fragvyom [A] and Valkyrie Fragvyom [B].


◆ Asterite Shop
1. New exclusive Modification Parts for the recommended weapons of Valkyrie Boltstorm and Valkyrie Blastmetal, and adjusted the order of display for purchasable items in the tab.

2. Added Valkyrie Boltstorm Fragments, Valkyrie Blastmetal Fragments, and Valkyrie Fragvyom [A]; and removed Sündenjäger, Ritual Imayoh, Gyakushinn Miko, Flame Sakitama, Arctic Kriegsmesser, and Luna Kindred from the purchasable Souls.

3. Removed the weekly purchase limit for Jingwei's Wings Parts and Blood Embrace Parts.

4. Removed the Augment Cores category, replaced it with Augment Core Option, and moved it to the Fragments category.


◆ Other Changes
1. Removed the Co-op Shop.

2. Valkyrie Fragvyom [A] in the shop will have more Battlesuit Fragments to choose from. Now, you will need to use Operation Terminals rather than Mind Stones to purchase it.

3. Removed Jingwei's Wings Parts and Blood Embrace Parts from the Logistics Terminal and Armada Terminal.



☆☆☆☆☆ Battle Pass ☆☆☆☆☆
◆ Added the following purchasable items to BP Works:
[Rank-up Stamp] Silverwing: N-EX Rank-up Stamp

[Weapon] Miracle Kissy Pillows

[Stigmata] Devil's Violinist set: Paganini (T, M, B)


◆ Unlock Paladin BP to receive Brilliance in the Air Ribbon.


◆ Unlock Knight BP/Paladin BP to get Exclusive Outfit Option BP Robevyom v7.3. Open it to receive one of the following: Midnight Martini (outfit), Let the Class End (outfit), Crimson Carol (outfit), Simply Orange (outfit), or 8000 Asterite.


◆ Replaced Mind Stone with Operation Terminal in the BP Store.



☆☆☆☆☆ System ☆☆☆☆☆
◆ Achievements
1. New achievement for obtaining Deepspace Anchor: First Light.

2. New achievement for obtaining Valkyrie Boltstorm.

3. New achievement for obtaining Valkyrie Blastmetal.


◆ Bridge Interactions
1. New bridge interactive animations and voice lines for Deepspace Anchor: First Light.

2. New bridge interactive animations and voice lines for Valkyrie Boltstorm.

3. New bridge interactive animations and voice lines for Valkyrie Blastmetal.


◆ System Screens Adjustments
1. Adjusted the battle screen and added a [Jump] button to the lower right corner of the control area.

2. Adjusted the Settings screen.

3. New way to play on PC: Keyboard and Mouse. You will be able to choose your favorite control mode from Controller, Keyboard and Mouse, and Keyboard. In the Keyboard and Mouse Mode, you can move the mouse around to control the character's perspective, cast Basic ATKs with the left mouse button, and perform evasions with the right mouse button during combat scenes.

4. New key position selection that offers two button layouts (Recommended Mode and Classic Mode). You can choose whichever one you prefer. The Ultimate and Jump buttons change position between the two options.

5. Adjusted the options on the Graphics Setting Screen. With the v7.3 update, the options will be automatically set to recommended tiers based on the performance of the device used for login.

*Due to the overall adjustments in options, the settings from before the v7.3 update will not be retained. You can adjust the graphics quality settings according to your preferences by navigating to the Graphics Setting screen.


◆ Bridge System
Unlocks Antares Building, Oxia upon starting the Part 2 main story Chapter I. You can switch to any owned bridges from Account Info → Change Bridge.


◆ Starter's System
1. Adjusted some rewards in the Starter's Manual event.

2. Adjusted some missions and required levels in the Starter's Manual, Sensei-Cadet System, Growth Regimen, and other events.


◆ Collection
A text color correction for some descriptions on Black Wine of Theramenes in the Collection has been made.


◆ Lobby
Removed the Supply tab in the Lobby.


◆ Resources
Added support for Chinese voice acting in the main story CG when Chinese is selected as the voice-over language in the Settings.



☆☆☆☆☆ Dorm ☆☆☆☆☆
Deepspace Anchor: First Light, Valkyrie Boltstorm, and Valkyrie Blastmetal can now move into the Dorm. Their interactions and events are now available.

1. Fixed an issue where crashes sometimes occurred on the Graphics Setting Screen on some iOS devices.


2. Fixed an issue where the hitboxes of some characters sometimes glitched when the game's FPS was unstable.


3. Fixed an issue where the hitboxes of some characters' bullets sometimes glitched.

notes.title: v7.2 The Wings to Mars Update Announcement
notes.content:
Welcome to v7.2: The Wings to Mars!

Remove all troubles and break free from all pains to understand the coming and going.
The heart is like a piece of porcelain that becomes shinier the more it is exposed to fire.
Now, the blaze that has been burning for tens of thousands of years has flared up once more.
New S-rank battlesuit Fenghuang of Vicissitude debuts!

The Star Which the Moon Gazes Upon event begins! Play the event to get Crystals and more!

Featured event Wild Phoenix Chase begins! Play the event to get Reverist Calico's new outfit Meowtose Macchiato, Crystals and more.

New event Realms of Battle begins! Play various themed stages and defeat final bosses to get Crystals, Einstein's Torus and more.



Update Content[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/41350040/63b01ee7dfb49f6a06c0edc8d9e67b4eb804b939.png[/img]
◆ New BIO-type S-rank battlesuit: Fenghuang of Vicissitude
Remove all troubles and break free from all pains to understand the coming and going. The heart is like a piece of porcelain that becomes shinier the more it is exposed to fire.

New S-rank battlesuit Fenghuang of Vicissitude debuts. As a BIO-type Fire DMG dealer, she has great survivability and can switch between Punch Stance and Kick Stance to fiercely attack enemies in battle. When casting Ultimate, she uses herself as a furnace for phoenix fire, and burns away her life to deliver an unparalleled blow.

※ You can obtain the new battlesuit and her recommended equipment in the following ways:
After the v7.2 update, you can participate in the Phoenix Fire Reburns Expansion Supply to obtain Fenghuang of Vicissitude. After specific numbers of drops, you will receive bonus rewards, including Vicissitude Option x3, Flaming Loyal Heart Equipment Option x1, Armory Growth Option x5, Material Option Type A x8, and Fenghuang of Vicissitude Rank-up Stamp x3.

After the v7.2 update, Implicit Simplicity Focused Supply will begin! The UP equipment of Focused Supply A are Fenghuang of Vicissitude's recommended weapon Torch of Eons, and Flavors of Time set: Fu Hua: Ordinary Day (T, M, B).


★ New Event: The Star Which the Moon Gazes Upon
"Imagine if he was fortunate enough to learn the humanity of today is finally treading the path he'd been yearning for — how do you think he'd react?"

New event The Star Which the Moon Gazes Upon begins! Play the event to help three mentors (Kiana, Bronya and Durandal) complete Helia and Coralie's training. Event rewards Crystals, Ancient Willpowers, AE Imaginons and more.


★ Featured Event: Wild Phoenix Chase
"You wanna know what happened? Isn't that obvious — I was riding a bike and singing with the Old Timer when our RV got hijacked by the Jingwei!"

Featured event Wild Phoenix Chase will be available in v7.2! In this event, travel with Fu Hua, Herrscher of Sentience and others to collect marbles and souvenirs during the journey. Use marbles to hit mechanisms and take back the camper!

Play the event to get Reverist Calico's new outfit Meowtose Macchiato, Crystals and more.


★ New Event: Realms of Battle
The realms of battle unfold. It is time to push past the limits and charge toward victory.

New event stages available. During the event, clear themed stages and defeat final bosses to get Crystals, Einstein's Torus and more.


★ Additions to the Hyperion Arsenal
◆ New Weapons: Fists Torch of Eons, and PRI-ARM fists Torch of Eons: Skyfire

◆ New Stigmata: Flavors of Time Set


★ Additions to the Dressing Room
◆ Sugary Starburst's outfit Tonight's My Time!

◆ Reverist Calico's outfit Meowtose Macchiato



Game Adjustments & Optimizations
☆☆☆☆☆ Characters ☆☆☆☆☆
The following data are at max skill level:
◆ Cosmic Expression
1. Fixed an issue where her Weapon Skill sometimes dealt damage to both Nihilus Shell and Nihilus Seed of IMG-type enemies.

2. Fixed an issue on the Valkyrie screen where her model sometimes glitched in Appreciation Mode.


◆ Herrscher of Rebirth
1. Fixed an issue where her skirt model sometimes experienced blurred displays when she was in the outfit Eternal Night's Embrace.

2. Fixed an issue where flower spirit Flora's animations sometimes glitched after she cast Combo ATK in Life Binder when she was in the outfit Eternal Night's Embrace.

3. Fixed an issue where her model sometimes glitched when she had specific bridge interactions.

4. Fixed an issue where her hair model sometimes glitched when continuously using the last hit of Basic ATK while wearing the outfit Eternal Night's Embrace in Elysian Realm.


◆ Herrscher of Finality

◆ Terminal Aide 0017
Optimized her character art display on the lineup screen when she was in the outfit Saccharine Lash-Out.


◆ Chrono Navi

◆ Starry Impression
Fixed an issue in the Skill screen where the icon for Combo ATK was displayed incorrectly.


◆ Disciplinary Perdition
1. Fixed an issue on the Skill Details screen where her model glitched.

2. A text correction of her skill Its Sin, Irredeemable at SS-rank, 1 star in the Rank-up system has been made, and it does not affect the actual skill effects.

notes.title: v7.1 Starbound Painter Update Announcement
notes.content:
For the girl who is always traveling through the galaxy, what kind of starry sky will she paint?

She left her footprints everywhere in the universe, and the stars gave her splendid colors in return.

New SP Battlesuit Cosmic Expression Debuts

The bonuses event Seize Sensational Sentience is available. Complete event missions to get Herrscher of Sentience Character Card!

Featured event Starry Voyage: Strike Back! is updated! Play the event to get Starchasm Nyx's new outfit On Fair Clouds, Crystals and more.

Story Chapter XLII Earthbound Order coming soon! Play the limited-time event to get 4★ event stigma Kiana: Cramming (T), Cosmic Expression Fragments, Crystals and more!

Winter bonuses event Gifts from Stars has been launched. Play the login event and complete active missions to get Crystal Option (L), Ancient Gift Boxes and more!

Update Content

★ New SD-type SP Battlesuit: Cosmic Expression

"For the girl who is always traveling through the galaxy, what kind of starry sky will she paint?

She left her footprints everywhere in the universe, and the stars gave her splendid colors in return."

◆ New SP battlesuit Cosmic Expression debuts! She is an SD-type support battlesuit dealing Bleed DMG. She wields a cross and uses the brush as a laser saber to fight enemies using the power of the stars.

※ You can obtain the new battlesuit and her recommended equipment in the following ways:

◆ After the v7.1 update, complete certain Open World Adventure Tasks to earn Cosmic Expression Fragments.

◆ From 04:00, DEC 11, Cosmic Expression Fragments will be sold in Asterite Shop. Purchase them with Asterite.

◆ During v7.1, you can play Starry Voyage: Strike Back!, Story Chapter XLII Earthbound Order and other events to get Cosmic Expression Fragments.

◆ After the v7.1 update and until 12:00, DEC 29, the SP Battlesuit Supply event Stars That Return to Dreams will be available! SP battlesuit Cosmic Expression is guaranteed in 25 drops. The Event Equipment Supply recommended for Cosmic Expression will also be available with increased drop rates for cross weapon Anchor of the Voyage and stigma set Passionate Dedication.

★ Featured Event: Starry Voyage: Strike Back!

"What do I see when I look up at the stars?"

"Do I see shining stars or boundless dark night?"

◆ Featured event Starry Voyage: Strike Back! begins. Captain, please team up with Griseo to storm the enemy's base using cards! Play the event to get Starchasm Nyx's new outfit On Fair Clouds, Crystals, Cosmic Expression Fragments, Energy Devices and more.

★ Story Chapter XLII: Earthbound Order

"The blind traveler trod in the nameless mist, and the seed of destruction silently grew."

◆ During v7.1, Story Chapter XLII will be updated. Play the event to get 4★ event stigma Kiana: Cramming (T), Cosmic Expression Fragments, Crystals and more!

★ Bonuses Event: Seize Sensational Sentience

◆ During the event, log in to complete specific event missions and get Herrscher of Sentience Character Card!

★ Outfit Supply: Feather Leaves from the Night

"The girl falls into the kingdom of night.

Here is a dim, sky-reaching tree whose dark, feathery leaves rustle and fall.

Beating, pounding...

Is a heart tainted by black."

◆ During v7.1, you can pull drops in the Outfit Supply Feather Leaves from the Night to obtain the featured outfit (Herrscher of Rebirth's outfit Eternal Night's Embrace) in 10 drops (costs 9600 Crystals).

★ Limited-time Top-up Bonuses: Starry Wishes

◆ During v7.1, the limited-time top-up bonuses event will be available! Top up and get Palatinus Equinox Rank-up Stamps or Infinite Ouroboros Rank-up Stamps, Supply Cards, Boosters and more to boost your Valkyries!

★ Outfit Shop New Arrivals

◆ After the v7.1 update and until 12:00, DEC 29, Terminal Aide 0017's new outfit Saccharine Lash-Out will be available in the Outfit Shop and sold with a discount at 1380 B-Chips instead of 1680 B-Chips in its launch week!

★ Additions to the Hyperion Arsenal

◆ New Weapons: Cross weapon Anchor of the Voyage, and PRI-ARM cross weapon Anchor of the Voyage: Interstellar

◆ New stigmata: Passionate Dedication set

★ Additions to the Dressing Room

◆ Herrscher of Rebirth's new outfit Eternal Night's Embrace

◆ Terminal Aide 0017's outfit Saccharine Lash-Out

◆ Starchasm Nyx's outfit On Fair Clouds

Game Adjustments & Optimizations

※※※※※ Battlesuits ※※※※※

The following data are at max skill level:

◆ Lunar Vow: Crimson Love

1. Fixed an issue where her QTE sometimes got erroneously triggered when a teammate cast Combo ATK but failed to deal damage.

2. Fixed an issue where her model sometimes glitched when evading upon entering a battle.

3. Fixed an issue where certain Weapon Skills sometimes failed to trigger her QTE.

4. Fixed incorrect text descriptions in her Valkyrie Battlesuit stories in the Dorm.

◆ Herrscher of Rebirth

2. Fixed an issue where obstructions sometimes occurred when a summoned Seed of Idea was exiting.

◆ Terminal Aide 0017

Fixed an issue that when she was equipped with certain fists weapons, her animations sometimes glitched when she cast Regen: Superpartner and connect into a Weapon Skill.

◆ Herrscher of Human: Ego

Fixed an issue where her animations sometimes glitched after jumping in certain stages.

◆ Spina Astera

Fixed an issue where her facial expressions sometimes glitched on the character's finalization screen.

◆ Palatinus Equinox

◆ Silverwing: N-EX

◆ Herrscher of Flamescion

◆ Herrscher of Sentience

◆ System Screens

1. Adjusted the bridge screen's button appearance and style, with the buttons on the right rearranged.

2. Adjusted the Valkyrie screen's layout and background effects, integrated the gear swap screen, and added the Glossary feature and a skill demo screen.

1. Optimized in-game audio and video management. You can now manage audio, video, voiceover, and multi-language image downloads and deletions in [Manage Resources] on the AiPhone.

※ Due to function integration, the previous option [Settings] > [Resources] will be removed.

2. The SD Package switching feature has been removed for iOS.

Cosmic Expression can now move into the Dorm. Her interactions and events are now available.

notes.title: v7.0 Re: Promise to Luna Update Announcement
notes.content:
Welcome to v7.0 Re: Promise to Luna!

Beneath the blood moon, the vampire finally embraced the long-anticipated reunion she had been eagerly waiting for.
The prolonged wait had transformed her disposition, yet her passionate yearning remained unaltered.


Update Content

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350040/e2385cfa243b636597a11f198dfb34c86af18a0f.png[/img]
◆ New PSY-type S-rank Battlesuit Lunar Vow: Crimson Love
"Thank you for taking my hand. I'm not going to let go of you from now on."
New S-rank battlesuit Lunar Vow: Crimson Love is a PSY-type battlesuit dealing Lightning DMG and Bleeding enemies. To rescue the dearest presence in her life, she brandishes a chainsaw with razor-sharp fangs in battle and relentlessly pursues her enemies beneath the blood moon.

※ You can obtain the new battlesuit and her recommended equipment in the following ways:
After the v7.0 update and until 12:00, NOV 24, Expansion Supply In the Name of Love will be available. The featured S-rank battlesuit Lunar Vow: Crimson Love is guaranteed in 100 drops.
Meanwhile, Crimson Banquet Focused Supply for cross weapon Bloodied Casket and stigma set Darkness Illuminated will be available. The Supply is free for the first 10 drops!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350040/f1cabce6ee1aa831ab38db9f61316052367140c2.png[/img]
◆ Featured Event: Captain's Ranch Tale
"The early bird catches the worm." After writing this down, the rancher decided to hit the snooze button before all else.
Featured event Captain's Ranch Tale begins. You can revive the ranch and build your home through planting, livestock, fishing and excavation. Play the event to get Dea Anchora's new outfit Pumping Heart, Crystals and more!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350040/05628d85405127994558ac36c81baf2d757eeb41.png[/img]

"They're like two people walking alongside each other, one can see the way ahead, while the other is blind."
Story Chapter XLI is updated. The new story is coming! Play the event to get 4★ event stigma Mei: Class Preparation (M), Crystals and more!

notes.title: Update Announcement - v6.8 Saha and Rebirth is Released!
notes.content:
Update Content


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350040/ae773f9ac6f6d2217a963afa17fc2923c6044892.png[/img]
◆ New PSY-type S-rank Herrscher Battlesuit Herrscher of Rebirth
New S-rank Herrscher battlesuit Herrscher of Rebirth debuts. As a PSY-type Physical DMG dealer, she can switch between Soul Shaper Form and Life Binder Form. In Soul Shaper Form, she supports teammates with combat buffs. In Life Binder Form, she acts as the DMG dealer for the team. Spirit deer Diana and flower spirit Flora will team up with her in the battle.

※ You can obtain the new battlesuit and her recommended equipment in the following ways:
After the v6.8 update and until 12:00, SEP 1, Shadow of Life Expansion Supply will be available. The featured S-rank battlesuit Herrscher of Rebirth is guaranteed in 100 drops. Meanwhile, the Focused Supply A Bloom of Life's Pistil for scythe Life Harvester's Song and stigma set Gracefully Alive will also open.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350040/b59d42a01ec871bad04b275cf63135a179143c73.png[/img]
◆ Bonuses Event: Hot Summer Gift! Book of Memories!
Hopefully, you can be brought back to the first encounter when you flip the book pages.

Summer Physical Prize Supply begins! Play the event for a chance to exchange for Honkai Impact 3rd Art Collection Vol.2: The Moon's Origin and Finality! After the v6.8 update and until 04:00, SEP 14, you can complete specific event missions to exchange for Honkai Impact 3rd Art Collection Vol.2: The Moon's Origin and Finality, Honkai Shards, Summer Reminiscence Weapon Option and more at the shop.

*Ai-chan's Reminder:
Open Summer Reminiscence Weapon Option to get one of the following: Whisper of the Past, Miracle Kissy Pillows, Purana Phantasma, Might of An-Utu, Fenghuang Down or Reroll Device: SP.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350040/cd20af3ac72fd85f921a132ae74ed6292af9c179.png[/img]
◆ Story Chapter XXXIX: Daughters of the Sea
What a great name! You can hear the rhythm of life from its tone, right?

Story Chapter XXXIX Daughters of the Sea is now available with the new limited-time event Chasing Light, Drinking Shadow. Play the event to get 4★ event stigma Misteln: Dressing (M), Crystals, Memento Wind Chimes, Ancient Willpowers and more~

*Ai-chan's Reminder:
You need to complete Story Chapter XXXVII and XXXVIII before playing Story Chapter XXXIX's limited-time event Chasing Light, Drinking Shadow in v6.8. After completing Story Chapter XXXVII and XXXVIII, you can get Memento Wind Chimes that can be used to exchange for Honkai Impact 3rd Art Collection Vol.2: The Moon's Origin and Finality and more! Hurry up to complete the story chapters soon!


◆ Featured Event: Before the Endless Dream Ends
Event Before the Endless Dream Ends will begin in v6.8. You will team up with Magic Girls to embark on a new journey and help them defeat mighty enemies. Play the event to get Darkbolt Jonin's new outfit Shimmering Wavelets, Crystals and more.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350040/12a8857c7cd5ddc8a24004e88e57fa1237470655.png[/img]

New Herrscher descends with bonuses! During the event, log in for 7 days to get Starlit Astrologos' new outfit Startold Fortune, Expansion Supply Cards, Crystals and more!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350040/4d649dffb4de31a545c20323286eb5ec394606e9.png[/img]
◆ Featured Event: Bunny Shop
Hmm, it's time to cheer up and welcome customers. Fans, welcome to the little shop of the flying bunny. Love you guys~

Bunny Shop opens! During the event, total spending rewards Dreamweaver's new outfit Silky Violet Dream, Collector's Cards, Supply Cards and more!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350040/856b1cc3ec76c2cf37a26aaae7006e696f650b49.png[/img]
◆ ELF: Project Bunny
According to the ELF, she is a mechanical life equipped with rationality and power and the heart and soul of Studio Reason... Of course, don't tell Bronya this!

Herrscher of Rebirth's recommended partner ELF Project Bunny is now available! When casting Ultimate, Project Bunny descends from the sky and smashes the target location with a giant carrot bomb, causing a huge explosion and dealing Physical DMG.

notes.title: From Finality, the Origin Version Kiana Update Announcement
notes.content:
New S-rank battlesuits Herrscher of Finality and Herrscher of Origin debut!

New featured event Bustling Holiday Symphony :|| is available! Play the event to get Fallen Rosemary's new outfit Sweet Osmanthus, 600 Crystals, Rabbit HOMU Emblem, Jade Moon Emblem, Reroll Device: ATK Option Type B, Einstein's Torus, Ancient Assist Gift Box 2023, Growth Assist Gift Box 2023 and more!

Bonuses event Origin, a Beginning begins! Complete missions to get Herrscher of Origin Character Card x1 and Heartfelt Origin Stigma Option x1!

There will also be Story Chapter XXXV, The Rare & Precious total spend bonuses event, Jade Knight's new outfit Auspicious Dazzle and more!


Update Content
◆ New IMG-type S-rank battlesuit Herrscher of Finality
She holds the key to humanity's transcendence beyond Finality and a brighter future.
"The authority comes from everyone's hard work... I'll take good care of it."

New S-rank battlesuit Herrscher of Finality debuts! She's a Fire DMG dealer who can perform different Combo ATK variants in Time Flint stance and Moon Blade stance to trigger Absolute Time Fracture and cast Combo ATK in Finale stance. When Herrscher of Origin and Herrscher of Truth are on the same team, Joint Ultimate can be cast.

*Ai-chan's Reminder:
For a better gaming experience, certain bridge interactions of Herrscher of Finality will be unlocked after Story Chapter XXXV Part 3 becomes available.


◆ New IMG-type S-rank battlesuit Herrscher of Origin
Together with her partners, she shall transcend the destiny that no one has ever overcome.
"Raiden Mei chose to protect humanity as a Herrscher."

New S-rank battlesuit Herrscher of Origin debuts! She's a Lightning DMG dealer who can cast well-timed Regressive Origin to stack Twisted Origin for Wing Blades, before casting Malice Expunged to attack enemies. Her Ultimate unleashes continuous slashes in desired directions. When Herrscher of Finality and Herrscher of Truth are on the same team, Joint Bursting can be cast, and her Ultimate triggers Herrscher of Finality's special QTE ATK.

※ You can obtain the new battlesuit in the following ways:
After Version Kiana update, you can complete Story Chapter XXXIII to get Heartfelt Origin Stigma Option, and complete Story Chapter XXXIV to get Herrscher of Origin Character Card!

During the Supply event Pure-minded Shadow, every 10 drops of the first 80 drops reward extra Focused Supply Card x5.


◆ Featured Event: Bustling Holiday Symphony :||
When spring is approaching, the small town is filled with a holiday vibe where visitors encounter stories and fireworks.

A brand-new side-scrolling shooter debuts! Play the event to get Fallen Rosemary's new outfit Sweet Osmanthus, 600 Crystals, Rabbit HOMU Emblem, Jade Moon Emblem, Reroll Device: ATK Option Type B, Einstein's Torus, Ancient Assist Gift Box 2023, Growth Assist Gift Box 2023, Dazzling Star Ribbon and more!
 

◆ Anniversary Celebration: Moonlit Fete for Our Brighter Fate
Participate in the anniversary 7-day login event to get Expansion Supply Card x10, Focused Supply Card x10, S-ranker Option x1, commemorative stigma Kiana: Evening Invite (B) and more.


◆ Story Chapter XXXV: Toward a New Tomorrow
"The Cocoon is just a mirror of yours after all."
"How you embrace humanity is how the Cocoon embraces humanity."

Story Chapter XXXV will be available in Version Kiana. You can play the main story event to get bridge theme Train to the Future, Stygian Nymph's outfit Estonia in Spring, 480 Crystals and more. You can also experience the limited-time bridge theme Above the Moon after Story Chapter XXXV becomes available and until Version Kiana ends.

Part 1 Finale login event will also be available in Version Kiana. You can log in to get 300 Crystals and 2,400 Asterite. During the event, you can also log in to check out Part 1 Finale Special Letter below the bridge and get Focused Supply Card x5.

There will also be special items for you to unlock! Please follow announcements for further details.


◆ Anniversary Spend Bonuses: The Rare & Precious
You can spend Crystals in Supply events to get Anniversary Orbs, which can be used to exchange for Herrscher of Flamescion Character Card, Herrscher of Flamescion/Spina Astera/Starchasm Nyx Rank-up Stamp in event shop The Rare & Precious! Spend about 30,000 Crystals to get Herrscher of Flamescion's outfit Flowering Luminance.


◆ Outfit Shop New Arrivals
Jade Knight's new outfit Auspicious Dazzle debuts. It's sold for 1,680 B-Chips after Version Kiana update and before 12:00, FEB 24. The price will return to 1980 B-Chips after its launch week.


◆ Additions to the Hyperion Arsenal
New weapons: Pistols Key of Anonymity, blade Key of Limpidity, PRI pistols Domain of Genesis and PRI blade Domain of Unity.

New stigmata: In the Name of Finality set Kiana Kaslana and In the Name of Origin set Raiden Mei.
